17771.label: Isaiah 1:1
17771.text: The vision of Isaiah the son of Aʹmoz that he visioned concerning Judah and Jerusalem in the days of Uz·ziʹah, Joʹtham, Aʹhaz [and] Hez·e·kiʹah, kings of Judah:

17772.label: Isaiah 1:2
17772.text: Hear, O heavens, and give ear, O earth, for Jehovah himself has spoken: “Sons I have brought up and raised, but they themselves have revolted against me.

17773.label: Isaiah 1:3
17773.text: A bull well knows its buyer, and the ass the manger of its owner; Israel itself has not known, my own people have not behaved understandingly.”

17774.label: Isaiah 1:4
17774.text: Woe to the sinful nation, the people heavy with error, an evildoing seed, ruinous sons! They have left Jehovah, they have treated the Holy One of Israel with disrespect, they have turned backwards.

17775.label: Isaiah 1:5
17775.text: Where else will YOU be struck still more, in that YOU add more revolt? The whole head is in a sick condition, and the whole heart is feeble.

17776.label: Isaiah 1:6
17776.text: From the sole of the foot even to the head there is no sound spot in it. Wounds and bruises and fresh stripes—they have not been squeezed out or bound up, nor has there been a softening with oil.

17777.label: Isaiah 1:7
17777.text: YOUR land is a desolation, YOUR cities are burned with fire; YOUR ground—right in front of YOU strangers are eating it up, and the desolation is like an overthrow by strangers.

17778.label: Isaiah 1:8
17778.text: And the daughter of Zion has been left remaining like a booth in a vineyard, like a lookout hut in a field of cucumbers, like a blockaded city.

17779.label: Isaiah 1:9
17779.text: Unless Jehovah of armies himself had left remaining to us just a few survivors, we should have become just like Sodʹom, we should have resembled Go·morʹrah itself.

17780.label: Isaiah 1:10
17780.text: Hear the word of Jehovah, YOU dictators of Sodʹom. Give ear to the law of our God, YOU people of Go·morʹrah.

17781.label: Isaiah 1:11
17781.text: “Of what benefit to me is the multitude of YOUR sacrifices?” says Jehovah. “I have had enough of whole burnt offerings of rams and the fat of well-fed animals; and in the blood of young bulls and male lambs and he-goats I have taken no delight.

17782.label: Isaiah 1:12
17782.text: When YOU people keep coming in to see my face, who is it that has required this from YOUR hand, to trample my courtyards?

17783.label: Isaiah 1:13
17783.text: Stop bringing in any more valueless grain offerings. Incense—it is something detestable to me. New moon and sabbath, the calling of a convention —I cannot put up with the [use of] uncanny power along with the solemn assembly.

17784.label: Isaiah 1:14
17784.text: YOUR new moons and YOUR festal seasons my soul has hated. To me they have become a burden; I have become tired of bearing [them].

17785.label: Isaiah 1:15
17785.text: And when YOU spread out YOUR palms, I hide my eyes from YOU. Even though YOU make many prayers, I am not listening; with bloodshed YOUR very hands have become filled.

17786.label: Isaiah 1:16
17786.text: Wash yourselves; make yourselves clean; remove the badness of YOUR dealings from in front of my eyes; cease to do bad.

17787.label: Isaiah 1:17
17787.text: Learn to do good; search for justice; set right the oppressor; render judgment for the fatherless boy; plead the cause of the widow.”

17788.label: Isaiah 1:18
17788.text: “Come, now, YOU people, and let us set matters straight between us,” says Jehovah. “Though the sins of YOU people should prove to be as scarlet, they will be made white just like snow; though they should be red like crimson cloth, they will become even like wool.

17789.label: Isaiah 1:19
17789.text: If YOU people show willingness and do listen, the good of the land YOU will eat.

17790.label: Isaiah 1:20
17790.text: But if YOU people refuse and are actually rebellious, with a sword YOU will be eaten up; for the very mouth of Jehovah has spoken [it].”

17791.label: Isaiah 1:21
17791.text: O how the faithful town has become a prostitute! She was full of justice; righteousness itself used to lodge in her, but now murderers.

17792.label: Isaiah 1:22
17792.text: Your silver itself has become scummy dross. Your wheat beer is diluted with water.

17793.label: Isaiah 1:23
17793.text: Your princes are stubborn and partners with thieves. Every one of them is a lover of a bribe and a chaser after gifts. For a fatherless boy they do not render judgment; and even the legal case of a widow does not get admittance to them.

17794.label: Isaiah 1:24
17794.text: Therefore the utterance of the [true] Lord, Jehovah of armies, the Powerful One of Israel, is: “Aha! I shall relieve myself of my adversaries, and I will avenge myself on my enemies.

17795.label: Isaiah 1:25
17795.text: And I will turn back my hand upon you, and I shall smelt away your scummy dross as with lye, and I will remove all your waste products.

17796.label: Isaiah 1:26
17796.text: And I will bring back again judges for you as at the first, and counselors for you as at the start. After this you will be called City of Righteousness, Faithful Town.

17797.label: Isaiah 1:27
17797.text: With justice Zion herself will be redeemed, and those returning of her, with righteousness.

17798.label: Isaiah 1:28
17798.text: And the crash of revolters and that of sinful ones will be at the same time, and those leaving Jehovah will come to their finish.

17799.label: Isaiah 1:29
17799.text: For they will be ashamed of the mighty trees that YOU people desired, and YOU will be abashed because of the gardens that YOU have chosen.

17800.label: Isaiah 1:30
17800.text: For YOU will become like a big tree the foliage of which is withering, and like a garden that has no water.

17801.label: Isaiah 1:31
17801.text: And the vigorous man will certainly become tow, and the product of his activity a spark; and both of them will certainly go up in flames at the same time, with no one to do the extinguishing.”

17802.label: Isaiah 2:1
17802.text: The thing that Isaiah the son of Aʹmoz visioned concerning Judah and Jerusalem:

17803.label: Isaiah 2:2
17803.text: And it must occur in the final part of the days [that] the mountain of the house of Jehovah will become firmly established above the top of the mountains, and it will certainly be lifted up above the hills; and to it all the nations must stream.

17804.label: Isaiah 2:3
17804.text: And many peoples will certainly go and say: “Come, YOU people, and let us go up to the mountain of Jehovah, to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will instruct us about his ways, and we will walk in his paths.” For out of Zion law will go forth, and the word of Jehovah out of Jerusalem.

17805.label: Isaiah 2:4
17805.text: And he will certainly render judgment among the nations and set matters straight respecting many peoples. And they will have to beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning shears. Nation will not lift up sword against nation, neither will they learn war anymore.

17806.label: Isaiah 2:5
17806.text: O men of the house of Jacob, come and let us walk in the light of Jehovah.

17807.label: Isaiah 2:6
17807.text: For you have forsaken your people, the house of Jacob. For they have become full of what is from the East, and they are practicers of magic like the Phi·lisʹtines, and with the children of foreigners they abound.

17808.label: Isaiah 2:7
17808.text: And their land is filled with silver and gold, and there is no limit to their treasures. And their land is filled with horses, and there is no limit to their chariots.

17809.label: Isaiah 2:8
17809.text: And their land is filled with valueless gods. To the work of one’s hands they bow down, to that which one’s fingers have made.

17810.label: Isaiah 2:9
17810.text: And earthling man bows down, and man becomes low, and you cannot possibly pardon them.

17811.label: Isaiah 2:10
17811.text: Enter into the rock and hide yourself in the dust because of the dreadfulness of Jehovah, and from his splendid superiority.

17812.label: Isaiah 2:11
17812.text: The haughty eyes of earthling man must become low, and the loftiness of men must bow down; and Jehovah alone must be put on high in that day.

17813.label: Isaiah 2:12
17813.text: For it is the day belonging to Jehovah of armies. It is upon everyone self-exalted and lofty and upon everyone lifted up or low;

17814.label: Isaiah 2:13
17814.text: and upon all the cedars of Lebʹa·non that are lofty and lifted up and upon all the massive trees of Baʹshan;

17815.label: Isaiah 2:14
17815.text: and upon all the lofty mountains and upon all the hills that are lifted up;

17816.label: Isaiah 2:15
17816.text: and upon every high tower and upon every fortified wall;

17817.label: Isaiah 2:16
17817.text: and upon all the ships of Tarʹshish and upon all desirable boats.

17818.label: Isaiah 2:17
17818.text: And the haughtiness of the earthling man must bow down, and the loftiness of men must become low; and Jehovah alone must be put on high in that day.

17819.label: Isaiah 2:18
17819.text: And the valueless gods themselves will pass away completely.

17820.label: Isaiah 2:19
17820.text: And people will enter into the caves of the rocks and into the holes of the dust because of the dreadfulness of Jehovah and from his splendid superiority, when he rises up for the earth to suffer shocks.

17821.label: Isaiah 2:20
17821.text: In that day the earthling man will throw his worthless gods of silver and his valueless gods of gold that they had made for him to bow before to the shrewmice and to the bats,

17822.label: Isaiah 2:21
17822.text: in order to enter into the holes in the rocks and into the clefts of the crags, because of the dreadfulness of Jehovah and from his splendid superiority, when he rises up for the earth to suffer shocks.

17823.label: Isaiah 2:22
17823.text: For YOUR own sakes, hold off from the earthling man, whose breath is in his nostrils, for on what basis is he himself to be taken into account?

17824.label: Isaiah 3:1
17824.text: For, look! the [true] Lord, Jehovah of armies, is removing from Jerusalem and from Judah support and stay, the whole support of bread and the whole support of water,

17825.label: Isaiah 3:2
17825.text: mighty man and warrior, judge and prophet, and practicer of divination and elderly man,

17826.label: Isaiah 3:3
17826.text: chief of fifty and highly respected man and counselor and expert in magical arts, and the skilled charmer.

17827.label: Isaiah 3:4
17827.text: And I shall certainly make boys their princes, and mere arbitrary power will rule over them.

17828.label: Isaiah 3:5
17828.text: And the people will actually tyrannize one over the other, even each one over his fellowman. They will storm, the boy against the old man, and the lightly esteemed one against the one to be honored.

17829.label: Isaiah 3:6
17829.text: For each one will lay hold of his brother in the house of his father, [saying:] “You have a mantle. A dictator you ought to become to us, and this overthrown mass should be under your hand.”

17830.label: Isaiah 3:7
17830.text: He will raise [his voice] in that day, saying: “I shall not become a wound dresser; and in my house there is neither bread nor a mantle. YOU men must not set me as dictator over the people.”

17831.label: Isaiah 3:8
17831.text: For Jerusalem has stumbled, and Judah itself has fallen, because their tongue and their dealings are against Jehovah, in behaving rebelliously in the eyes of his glory.

17832.label: Isaiah 3:9
17832.text: The very expression of their faces actually testifies against them, and of their sin like that of Sodʹom they do tell. They have not hidden [it]. Woe to their soul! For they have dealt out to themselves calamity.

17833.label: Isaiah 3:10
17833.text: Say, YOU men, that it [will be] well with the righteous one, for they will eat the very fruitage of their dealings.

17834.label: Isaiah 3:11
17834.text: Woe to the wicked one!—Calamity; for the treatment [rendered] by his own hands will be rendered to him!

17835.label: Isaiah 3:12
17835.text: As for my people, its task assigners are dealing severely, and mere women actually rule over it. O my people, those leading you on are causing [you] to wander, and the way of your paths they have confused.

17836.label: Isaiah 3:13
17836.text: Jehovah is stationing himself to contend and is standing up to pass sentence upon peoples.

17837.label: Isaiah 3:14
17837.text: Jehovah himself will enter into judgment with the elderly ones of his people and its princes. “And YOU yourselves have burned down the vineyard. What was taken by robbery from the afflicted one is in YOUR houses.

17838.label: Isaiah 3:15
17838.text: What do YOU men mean in that YOU crush my people, and that YOU grind the very faces of the afflicted ones?” is the utterance of the Sovereign Lord, Jehovah of armies.

17839.label: Isaiah 3:16
17839.text: And Jehovah says: “For the reason that the daughters of Zion have become haughty and they walk with their throats stretched forth and ogling with their eyes, they go walking with tripping steps, and with their feet they make a tinkling sound,

17840.label: Isaiah 3:17
17840.text: Jehovah also will actually make the crown of the head of the daughters of Zion scabby, and Jehovah himself will lay their very forehead bare.

17841.label: Isaiah 3:18
17841.text: In that day Jehovah will take away the beauty of the bangles and the headbands and the moon-shaped ornaments,

17842.label: Isaiah 3:19
17842.text: the eardrops and the bracelets and the veils,

17843.label: Isaiah 3:20
17843.text: the headdresses and the step chains and the breastbands and the ‘houses of the soul’ and the ornamental humming shells,

17844.label: Isaiah 3:21
17844.text: the finger rings and the nose rings,

17845.label: Isaiah 3:22
17845.text: the robes of state and the overtunics and the cloaks and the purses,

17846.label: Isaiah 3:23
17846.text: and the hand mirrors and the undergarments and the turbans and the large veils.

17847.label: Isaiah 3:24
17847.text: “And it must occur that instead of balsam oil there will come to be merely a musty smell; and instead of a belt, a rope; and instead of an artistic hair arrangement, baldness; and instead of a rich garment, a girding of sackcloth; a brand mark instead of prettiness.

17848.label: Isaiah 3:25
17848.text: By the sword your own men will fall, and your mightiness by war.

17849.label: Isaiah 3:26
17849.text: And her entrances will have to mourn and express sorrow, and she will certainly be cleaned out. She will sit down on the very earth.”

17850.label: Isaiah 4:1
17850.text: And seven women will actually grab hold of one man in that day, saying: “We shall eat our own bread and wear our own mantles; only may we be called by your name to take away our reproach.”

17851.label: Isaiah 4:2
17851.text: In that day what Jehovah makes sprout will come to be for decoration and for glory, and the fruitage of the land will be something to be proud of and something beautiful for those of Israel who have escaped.

17852.label: Isaiah 4:3
17852.text: And it must occur that the ones remaining in Zion and the ones left over in Jerusalem will be said to be holy to him, everyone written down for life in Jerusalem.

17853.label: Isaiah 4:4
17853.text: When Jehovah will have washed away the excrement of the daughters of Zion and he will rinse away even the bloodshed of Jerusalem from within her by the spirit of judgment and by the spirit of burning down,

17854.label: Isaiah 4:5
17854.text: Jehovah will also certainly create over every established place of Mount Zion and over her convention place a cloud by day and a smoke, and the brightness of a flaming fire by night; because over all the glory there will be a shelter.

17855.label: Isaiah 4:6
17855.text: And there will come to be a booth for a shade by day from the dry heat, and for a refuge and for a hiding place from the rainstorm and from the precipitation.

17856.label: Isaiah 5:1
17856.text: Let me sing, please, to my beloved one a song of my loved one concerning his vineyard. There was a vineyard that my beloved one came to have on a fruitful hillside.

17857.label: Isaiah 5:2
17857.text: And he proceeded to dig it up and to rid it of stones and to plant it with a choice red vine, and to build a tower in the middle of it. And there was also a winepress that he hewed out in it. And he kept hoping for it to produce grapes, but it gradually produced wild grapes.

17858.label: Isaiah 5:3
17858.text: “And now, O YOU inhabitants of Jerusalem and YOU men of Judah, please judge between me and my vineyard.

17859.label: Isaiah 5:4
17859.text: What is there yet to do for my vineyard that I have not already done in it? Why is it that I hoped for it to produce grapes, but it gradually produced wild grapes?

17860.label: Isaiah 5:5
17860.text: And now, please, may I make known to YOU men what I am doing to my vineyard: There will be a removing of its hedge, and it must be destined for burning down. There must be a breaking down of its stone wall, and it must be destined for a place of trampling.

17861.label: Isaiah 5:6
17861.text: And I shall set it as a thing destroyed. It will not be pruned, nor will it be hoed. And it must come up with the thornbush and weeds; and upon the clouds I shall lay a command to keep from precipitating any rain upon it.

17862.label: Isaiah 5:7
17862.text: For the vineyard of Jehovah of armies is the house of Israel, and the men of Judah are the plantation of which he was fond. And he kept hoping for judgment, but, look! the breaking of law; for righteousness, but, look! an outcry.”

17863.label: Isaiah 5:8
17863.text: Woe to the ones joining house to house, [and] those who annex field to field until there is no more room and YOU men have been made to dwell all by yourselves in the midst of the land!

17864.label: Isaiah 5:9
17864.text: In my ears Jehovah of armies [has sworn that] many houses, though great and good, will become an outright object of astonishment, without an inhabitant.

17865.label: Isaiah 5:10
17865.text: For even ten acres of vineyard will produce but one bath measure, and even a hoʹmer measure of seed will produce but an eʹphah measure.

17866.label: Isaiah 5:11
17866.text: Woe to those who are getting up early in the morning that they may seek just intoxicating liquor, who are lingering till late in the evening darkness so that wine itself inflames them!

17867.label: Isaiah 5:12
17867.text: And there must prove to be harp and stringed instrument, tambourine and flute, and wine at their feasts; but the activity of Jehovah they do not look at, and the work of his hands they have not seen.

17868.label: Isaiah 5:13
17868.text: Therefore my people will have to go into exile for lack of knowledge; and their glory will be famished men, and their crowd will be parched with thirst.

17869.label: Isaiah 5:14
17869.text: Therefore Sheʹol has made its soul spacious and has opened its mouth wide beyond bounds; and what is splendid in her, also her crowd and her uproar and the exultant one, will certainly go down into it.

17870.label: Isaiah 5:15
17870.text: And earthling man will bow down, and man will become low, and even the eyes of the high ones will become low.

17871.label: Isaiah 5:16
17871.text: And Jehovah of armies will become high through judgment, and the [true] God, the Holy One, will certainly sanctify himself through righteousness.

17872.label: Isaiah 5:17
17872.text: And the male lambs will actually graze as in their pasture; and the desolate places of well-fed animals alien residents will eat.

17873.label: Isaiah 5:18
17873.text: Woe to those drawing error with ropes of untruth, and as with wagon cords sin;

17874.label: Isaiah 5:19
17874.text: those who are saying: “Let his work hasten; do let it come quickly, in order that we may see [it]; and let the counsel of the Holy One of Israel draw near and come, that we may know [it]!”

17875.label: Isaiah 5:20
17875.text: Woe to those who are saying that good is bad and bad is good, those who are putting darkness for light and light for darkness, those who are putting bitter for sweet and sweet for bitter!

17876.label: Isaiah 5:21
17876.text: Woe to those wise in their own eyes and discreet even in front of their own faces!

17877.label: Isaiah 5:22
17877.text: Woe to those who are mighty in drinking wine, and to the men with vital energy for mixing intoxicating liquor,

17878.label: Isaiah 5:23
17878.text: those who are pronouncing the wicked one righteous in consideration of a bribe, and who take away even the righteousness of the righteous one from him!

17879.label: Isaiah 5:24
17879.text: Therefore just as a tongue of fire eats up the stubble and into the flames mere dried grass sinks down, their very rootstock will become just like a musty smell, and their blossom itself will go up just like powder, because they have rejected the law of Jehovah of armies, and the saying of the Holy One of Israel they have disrespected.

17880.label: Isaiah 5:25
17880.text: That is why the anger of Jehovah has grown hot against his people, and he will stretch out his hand against them and strike them. And the mountains will be agitated, and their dead bodies will become like the offal in the midst of the streets. In view of all this his anger has not turned back, but his hand is stretched out still.

17881.label: Isaiah 5:26
17881.text: And he has raised up a signal to a great nation far away, and he has whistled to it at the extremity of the earth; and, look! in haste it will swiftly come in.

17882.label: Isaiah 5:27
17882.text: There is no one tired nor is anyone stumbling among them. No one is drowsy and no one sleeps. And the belt around their loins will certainly not be opened, nor the laces of their sandals be torn in two;

17883.label: Isaiah 5:28
17883.text: because their arrows are sharpened and all their bows are bent. The very hoofs of their horses will have to be accounted as flint itself, and their wheels as a storm wind.

17884.label: Isaiah 5:29
17884.text: The roaring of theirs is like that of a lion, and they roar like maned young lions. And they will growl and grab hold of the prey and bring [it] safely away, and there will be no deliverer.

17885.label: Isaiah 5:30
17885.text: And they will growl over it in that day as with the growling of the sea. And one will actually gaze at the land, and, look! there is distressing darkness; and even the light has grown dark because of the drops falling on it.

17886.label: Isaiah 6:1
17886.text: In the year that King Uz·ziʹah died I, however, got to see Jehovah, sitting on a throne lofty and lifted up, and his skirts were filling the temple.

17887.label: Isaiah 6:2
17887.text: Seraphs were standing above him. Each one had six wings. With two he kept his face covered, and with two he kept his feet covered, and with two he would fly about.

17888.label: Isaiah 6:3
17888.text: And this one called to that one and said: “Holy, holy, holy is Jehovah of armies. The fullness of all the earth is his glory.”

17889.label: Isaiah 6:4
17889.text: And the pivots of the thresholds began to quiver at the voice of the one calling, and the house itself gradually filled with smoke.

17890.label: Isaiah 6:5
17890.text: And I proceeded to say: “Woe to me! For I am as good as brought to silence, because a man unclean in lips I am, and in among a people unclean in lips I am dwelling; for my eyes have seen the King, Jehovah of armies, himself!”

17891.label: Isaiah 6:6
17891.text: At that, one of the seraphs flew to me, and in his hand there was a glowing coal that he had taken with tongs off the altar.

17892.label: Isaiah 6:7
17892.text: And he proceeded to touch my mouth and to say: “Look! This has touched your lips, and your error has departed and your sin itself is atoned for.”

17893.label: Isaiah 6:8
17893.text: And I began to hear the voice of Jehovah saying: “Whom shall I send, and who will go for us?” And I proceeded to say: “Here I am! Send me.”

17894.label: Isaiah 6:9
17894.text: And he went on to say: “Go, and you must say to this people, ‘Hear again and again, O men, but do not understand; and see again and again, but do not get any knowledge.’

17895.label: Isaiah 6:10
17895.text: Make the heart of this people unreceptive, and make their very ears unresponsive, and paste their very eyes together, that they may not see with their eyes and with their ears they may not hear, and that their own heart may not understand and that they may not actually turn back and get healing for themselves.”

17896.label: Isaiah 6:11
17896.text: At this I said: “How long, O Jehovah?” Then he said: “Until the cities actually crash in ruins, to be without an inhabitant, and the houses be without earthling man, and the ground itself is ruined into a desolation;

17897.label: Isaiah 6:12
17897.text: and Jehovah actually removes earthling men far away, and the deserted condition does become very extensive in the midst of the land.

17898.label: Isaiah 6:13
17898.text: And there will still be in it a tenth, and it must again become something for burning down, like a big tree and like a massive tree in which, when there is a cutting down [of them], there is a stump; a holy seed will be the stump of it.”

17899.label: Isaiah 7:1
17899.text: Now it came about in the days of Aʹhaz the son of Joʹtham the son of Uz·ziʹah, the king of Judah, that Reʹzin the king of Syria and Peʹkah the son of Rem·a·liʹah, the king of Israel, came up to Jerusalem for war against it, and he proved unable to war against it.

17900.label: Isaiah 7:2
17900.text: And a report was made to the house of David, saying: “Syria has leaned upon Eʹphra·im.” And his heart and the heart of his people began to quiver, like the quivering of the trees of the forest because of a wind.

17901.label: Isaiah 7:3
17901.text: And Jehovah proceeded to say to Isaiah: “Go out, please, to meet Aʹhaz, you and Sheʹar-jaʹshub your son, to the end of the conduit of the upper pool by the highway of the laundryman’s field.

17902.label: Isaiah 7:4
17902.text: And you must say to him, ‘Watch yourself and keep undisturbed. Do not be afraid, and do not let your heart itself be timid because of the two tail ends of these smoking logs, because of the hot anger of Reʹzin and Syria and the son of Rem·a·liʹah,

17903.label: Isaiah 7:5
17903.text: for the reason that Syria [with] Eʹphra·im and the son of Rem·a·liʹah has advised what is bad against you, saying:

17904.label: Isaiah 7:6
17904.text: “Let us go up against Judah and tear it apart and by breakthroughs take it for ourselves; and let us make another king reign inside it, the son of Tabʹe·el.”

17905.label: Isaiah 7:7
17905.text: “‘This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah has said: “It will not stand, neither will it take place.

17906.label: Isaiah 7:8
17906.text: For the head of Syria is Damascus, and the head of Damascus is Reʹzin; and within just sixty-five years Eʹphra·im will be shattered to pieces so as not to be a people.

17907.label: Isaiah 7:9
17907.text: And the head of Eʹphra·im is Sa·marʹi·a, and the head of Sa·marʹi·a is the son of Rem·a·liʹah. Unless YOU people have faith, YOU will in that case not be of long duration.”’”

17908.label: Isaiah 7:10
17908.text: And Jehovah went on speaking some more to Aʹhaz, saying:

17909.label: Isaiah 7:11
17909.text: “Ask for yourself a sign from Jehovah your God, making it as deep as Sheʹol or making it high as the upper regions.”

17910.label: Isaiah 7:12
17910.text: But Aʹhaz said: “I shall not ask, neither shall I put Jehovah to the test.”

17911.label: Isaiah 7:13
17911.text: And he proceeded to say: “Listen, please, O house of David. Is it such a little thing for YOU to tire out men, that YOU should also tire out my God?

17912.label: Isaiah 7:14
17912.text: Therefore Jehovah himself will give YOU men a sign: Look! The maiden herself will actually become pregnant, and she is giving birth to a son, and she will certainly call his name Im·manʹu·el.

17913.label: Isaiah 7:15
17913.text: Butter and honey he will eat by the time that he knows how to reject the bad and choose the good.

17914.label: Isaiah 7:16
17914.text: For before the boy will know how to reject the bad and choose the good, the ground of whose two kings you are feeling a sickening dread will be left entirely.

17915.label: Isaiah 7:17
17915.text: Jehovah will bring against you and against your people and against the house of your father days such as have not come since the day of Eʹphra·im’s turning away from alongside Judah, namely, the king of As·syrʹi·a.

17916.label: Isaiah 7:18
17916.text: “And it must occur in that day that Jehovah will whistle for the flies that are at the extremity of the Nile canals of Egypt and for the bees that are in the land of As·syrʹi·a,

17917.label: Isaiah 7:19
17917.text: and they will certainly come in and settle down, all of them, upon the precipitous torrent valleys and upon the clefts of the crags and upon all the thorn thickets and upon all the watering places.

17918.label: Isaiah 7:20
17918.text: “In that day, by means of a hired razor in the region of the River, even by means of the king of As·syrʹi·a, Jehovah will shave the head and the hair of the feet, and it will sweep away even the beard itself.

17919.label: Isaiah 7:21
17919.text: “And it must occur in that day that an individual will preserve alive a young cow of the herd and two sheep.

17920.label: Isaiah 7:22
17920.text: And it must occur that, due to the abundance of the producing of milk, he will eat butter; because butter and honey are what everyone left remaining in the midst of the land will eat.

17921.label: Isaiah 7:23
17921.text: “And it must occur in that day that every place where there used to be a thousand vines, worth a thousand pieces of silver, will come to be—for the thornbushes and for the weeds it will come to be.

17922.label: Isaiah 7:24
17922.text: With arrows and the bow he will come there, because all the land will become mere thornbushes and weeds.

17923.label: Isaiah 7:25
17923.text: And all the mountains that used to be cleared of troublesome plants with a hoe—you will not come there for fear of thornbushes and weeds; and it will certainly become a place for letting bulls loose and a trampling ground of sheep.”

17924.label: Isaiah 8:1
17924.text: And Jehovah proceeded to say to me: “Take for yourself a large tablet and write upon it with the stylus of mortal man, ‘Maʹher-shalʹal-hash-baz.’

17925.label: Isaiah 8:2
17925.text: And let me have attestation for myself by faithful witnesses, U·riʹah the priest and Zech·a·riʹah the son of Je·ber·e·chiʹah.”

17926.label: Isaiah 8:3
17926.text: Then I went near to the prophetess, and she came to be pregnant and in time gave birth to a son. Jehovah now said to me: “Call his name Maʹher-shalʹal-hash-baz,

17927.label: Isaiah 8:4
17927.text: for before the boy will know how to call out, ‘My father!’ and ‘My mother!’ one will carry away the resources of Damascus and the spoil of Sa·marʹi·a before the king of As·syrʹi·a.”

17928.label: Isaiah 8:5
17928.text: And Jehovah proceeded to speak yet further to me, saying:

17929.label: Isaiah 8:6
17929.text: “For the reason that this people has rejected the waters of the Shi·loʹah that are going gently, and there is exultation over Reʹzin and the son of Rem·a·liʹah;

17930.label: Isaiah 8:7
17930.text: even therefore, look! Jehovah is bringing up against them the mighty and the many waters of the River, the king of As·syrʹi·a and all his glory. And he will certainly come up over all his streambeds and go over all his banks

17931.label: Isaiah 8:8
17931.text: and move on through Judah. He will actually flood and pass over. Up to the neck he will reach. And the outspreading of his wings must occur to fill the breadth of your land, O Im·manʹu·el!”

17932.label: Isaiah 8:9
17932.text: Be injurious, O YOU peoples, and be shattered to pieces; and give ear, all YOU in distant parts of the earth! Gird yourselves, and be shattered to pieces! Gird yourselves, and be shattered to pieces!

17933.label: Isaiah 8:10
17933.text: Plan out a scheme, and it will be broken up! Speak any word, and it will not stand, for God is with us!

17934.label: Isaiah 8:11
17934.text: For this is what Jehovah has said to me with strongness of the hand, that he may make me turn aside from walking in the way of this people, saying:

17935.label: Isaiah 8:12
17935.text: “YOU men must not say, ‘A conspiracy!’ respecting all that of which this people keep saying, ‘A conspiracy!’ and the object of their fear YOU men must not fear, nor must YOU tremble at it.

17936.label: Isaiah 8:13
17936.text: Jehovah of armies—he is the One whom YOU should treat as holy, and he should be the object of YOUR fear, and he should be the One causing YOU to tremble.”

17937.label: Isaiah 8:14
17937.text: And he must become as a sacred place; but as a stone to strike against and as a rock over which to stumble to both the houses of Israel, as a trap and as a snare to the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

17938.label: Isaiah 8:15
17938.text: And many among them will be certain to stumble and to fall and be broken, and to be snared and caught.

17939.label: Isaiah 8:16
17939.text: Wrap up the attestation, put a seal about the law among my disciples!

17940.label: Isaiah 8:17
17940.text: And I will keep in expectation of Jehovah, who is concealing his face from the house of Jacob, and I will hope in him.

17941.label: Isaiah 8:18
17941.text: Look! I and the children whom Jehovah has given me are as signs and as miracles in Israel from Jehovah of armies, who is residing in Mount Zion.

17942.label: Isaiah 8:19
17942.text: And in case they should say to YOU people: “Apply to the spiritistic mediums or to those having a spirit of prediction who are chirping and making utterances in low tones,” is it not to its God that any people should apply? [Should there be application] to dead persons in behalf of living persons?

17943.label: Isaiah 8:20
17943.text: To the law and to the attestation! Surely they will keep saying what is according to this statement that will have no light of dawn.

17944.label: Isaiah 8:21
17944.text: And each one will certainly pass through the land hard pressed and hungry; and it must occur that because he is hungry and has made himself feel indignant, he will actually call down evil upon his king and upon his God and will certainly peer upward.

17945.label: Isaiah 8:22
17945.text: And to the earth he will look, and, lo! distress and darkness, obscurity, hard times and gloominess with no brightness.

17946.label: Isaiah 9:1
17946.text: However, the obscureness will not be as when the land had stress, as at the former time when one treated with contempt the land of Zebʹu·lun and the land of Naphʹta·li and when at the later time one caused [it] to be honored —the way by the sea, in the region of the Jordan, Galʹi·lee of the nations.

17947.label: Isaiah 9:2
17947.text: The people that were walking in the darkness have seen a great light. As for those dwelling in the land of deep shadow, light itself has shone upon them.

17948.label: Isaiah 9:3
17948.text: You have made the nation populous; for it you have made the rejoicing great. They have rejoiced before you as with the rejoicing in the harvesttime, as those who are joyful when they divide up the spoil.

17949.label: Isaiah 9:4
17949.text: For the yoke of their load and the rod upon their shoulders, the staff of the one driving them to work, you have shattered to pieces as in the day of Midʹi·an.

17950.label: Isaiah 9:5
17950.text: For every boot of the one tramping with tremors and the mantle rolled in blood have even come to be for burning as food for fire.

17951.label: Isaiah 9:6
17951.text: For there has been a child born to us, there has been a son given to us; and the princely rule will come to be upon his shoulder. And his name will be called Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Eternal Father, Prince of Peace.

17952.label: Isaiah 9:7
17952.text: To the abundance of the princely rule and to peace there will be no end, upon the throne of David and upon his kingdom in order to establish it firmly and to sustain it by means of justice and by means of righteousness, from now on and to time indefinite. The very zeal of Jehovah of armies will do this.

17953.label: Isaiah 9:8
17953.text: There was a word that Jehovah sent against Jacob, and it fell upon Israel.

17954.label: Isaiah 9:9
17954.text: And the people will certainly know [it], even all of them, Eʹphra·im and the inhabitant of Sa·marʹi·a, because of [their] haughtiness and because of [their] insolence of heart in saying:

17955.label: Isaiah 9:10
17955.text: “Bricks are what have fallen, but with hewn stone we shall build. Sycamore trees are what have been cut down, but with cedars we shall make replacement.”

17956.label: Isaiah 9:11
17956.text: And Jehovah will set the adversaries of Reʹzin on high against him, and the enemies of that one he will goad on,

17957.label: Isaiah 9:12
17957.text: Syria from the east and the Phi·lisʹtines from behind, and they will eat up Israel with open mouth. In view of all this his anger has not turned back, but his hand is stretched out still.

17958.label: Isaiah 9:13
17958.text: And the people themselves have not returned to the One striking them, and Jehovah of armies they have not sought.

17959.label: Isaiah 9:14
17959.text: And Jehovah will cut off from Israel head and tail, shoot and rush, in one day.

17960.label: Isaiah 9:15
17960.text: The aged and highly respected one is the head, and the prophet giving false instruction is the tail.

17961.label: Isaiah 9:16
17961.text: And those who are leading this people on prove to be the ones causing [them] to wander; and those of them who are being led on, the ones who are being confused.

17962.label: Isaiah 9:17
17962.text: That is why Jehovah will not rejoice even over their young men, and upon their fatherless boys and upon their widows he will have no mercy; because all of them are apostates and evildoers and every mouth is speaking senselessness. In view of all this his anger has not turned back, but his hand is stretched out still.

17963.label: Isaiah 9:18
17963.text: For wickedness has become aflame just like a fire; thornbushes and weeds it will eat up. And it will catch fire in the thickets of the forest, and they will be borne aloft as the billowing of smoke.

17964.label: Isaiah 9:19
17964.text: In the fury of Jehovah of armies the land has been set afire, and the people will become as food for the fire. No one will show compassion even on his brother.

17965.label: Isaiah 9:20
17965.text: And one will cut down on the right and will certainly be hungry; and one will eat on the left, and they will certainly not be satisfied. They will each one eat the flesh of his own arm,

17966.label: Isaiah 9:21
17966.text: Ma·nasʹseh Eʹphra·im, and Eʹphra·im Ma·nasʹseh. Together they will be against Judah. In view of all this his anger has not turned back, but his hand is stretched out still.

17967.label: Isaiah 10:1
17967.text: Woe to those who are enacting harmful regulations and those who, constantly writing, have written out sheer trouble,

17968.label: Isaiah 10:2
17968.text: in order to push away the lowly ones from a legal case and to wrest away justice from the afflicted ones of my people, for the widows to become their spoil, and that they may plunder even the fatherless boys!

17969.label: Isaiah 10:3
17969.text: And what will YOU men do at the day of being given attention and at the ruin, when it comes from far away? Toward whom will YOU flee for assistance, and where will YOU leave YOUR glory,

17970.label: Isaiah 10:4
17970.text: except it be that one must bow down under the prisoners and that people keep falling under those who have been killed? In view of all this his anger has not turned back, but his hand is stretched out still.

17971.label: Isaiah 10:5
17971.text: “Aha, the As·syrʹi·an, the rod for my anger, and the stick that is in their hand for my denunciation!

17972.label: Isaiah 10:6
17972.text: Against an apostate nation I shall send him, and against the people of my fury I shall issue a command to him, to take much spoil and to take much plunder and to make it a trampling place like the clay of the streets.

17973.label: Isaiah 10:7
17973.text: Though he may not be that way, he will feel inclined; though his heart may not be that way, he will scheme, because to annihilate is in his heart, and to cut off nations not a few.

17974.label: Isaiah 10:8
17974.text: For he will say, ‘Are not my princes at the same time kings?

17975.label: Isaiah 10:9
17975.text: Is not Calʹno just like Carʹche·mish? Is not Haʹmath just like Arʹpad? Is not Sa·marʹi·a just like Damascus?

17976.label: Isaiah 10:10
17976.text: Whenever my hand has reached the kingdoms of the valueless god whose graven images are more than those at Jerusalem and at Sa·marʹi·a,

17977.label: Isaiah 10:11
17977.text: will it not be that just as I shall have done to Sa·marʹi·a and to her valueless gods, even so I shall do to Jerusalem and to her idols?’

17978.label: Isaiah 10:12
17978.text: “And it must occur that when Jehovah terminates all his work in Mount Zion and in Jerusalem, I shall make an accounting for the fruitage of the insolence of the heart of the king of As·syrʹi·a and for the self-importance of his loftiness of eyes.

17979.label: Isaiah 10:13
17979.text: For he has said, ‘With the power of my hand I shall certainly act, and with my wisdom, for I do have understanding; and I shall remove the boundaries of peoples, and their things stored up I shall certainly pillage, and I shall bring down the inhabitants just like a powerful one.

17980.label: Isaiah 10:14
17980.text: And just as if a nest, my hand will reach the resources of the peoples; and just as when one gathers eggs that have been left, I myself will gather up even all the earth, and there will certainly be no one fluttering [his] wings or opening [his] mouth or chirping.’”

17981.label: Isaiah 10:15
17981.text: Will the ax enhance itself over the one chopping with it, or the saw magnify itself over the one moving it back and forth, as though the staff moved back and forth the ones raising it on high, as though the rod raised on high the one who is not wood?

17982.label: Isaiah 10:16
17982.text: Therefore the [true] Lord, Jehovah of armies, will keep sending upon his fat ones a wasting disease, and under his glory a burning will keep burning away like the burning of a fire.

17983.label: Isaiah 10:17
17983.text: And Israel’s Light must become a fire, and his Holy One a flame; and it must blaze up and eat up his weeds and his thornbushes in one day.

17984.label: Isaiah 10:18
17984.text: And the glory of his forest and of his orchard He will bring to an end, even from the soul clear to the flesh, and it must become like the melting away of one that is ailing.

17985.label: Isaiah 10:19
17985.text: And the rest of the trees of his forest—they will become such a number that a mere boy will be able to write them down.

17986.label: Isaiah 10:20
17986.text: And it will certainly occur in that day that those remaining over of Israel and those who have escaped of the house of Jacob will never again support themselves upon the one striking them, and they will certainly support themselves upon Jehovah, the Holy One of Israel, in trueness.

17987.label: Isaiah 10:21
17987.text: A mere remnant will return, the remnant of Jacob, to the Mighty God.

17988.label: Isaiah 10:22
17988.text: For although your people, O Israel, would prove to be like the grains of sand of the sea, a mere remnant among them will return. An extermination decided upon will be flooding through in righteousness,

17989.label: Isaiah 10:23
17989.text: because an exterminating and a strict decision the Sovereign Lord, Jehovah of armies, will be executing in the midst of the whole land.

17990.label: Isaiah 10:24
17990.text: Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord, Jehovah of armies, has said: “Do not be afraid, O my people who are dwelling in Zion, because of the As·syrʹi·an, who with the rod used to strike [you] and who used to lift up his own staff against you in the way that Egypt did.

17991.label: Isaiah 10:25
17991.text: For yet a very little while—and the denunciation will have come to an end, and my anger, in their wearing away.

17992.label: Isaiah 10:26
17992.text: And Jehovah of armies will certainly brandish against him a whip as at the defeat of Midʹi·an by the rock Oʹreb; and his staff will be upon the sea, and he will certainly lift it up in the way that he did with Egypt.

17993.label: Isaiah 10:27
17993.text: “And it must occur in that day that his load will depart from upon your shoulder, and his yoke from upon your neck, and the yoke will certainly be wrecked because of the oil.”

17994.label: Isaiah 10:28
17994.text: He has come upon Aiʹath; he has passed along through Migʹron; at Michʹmash he deposits his articles.

17995.label: Isaiah 10:29
17995.text: They have passed over the ford, Geʹba is a place for them to spend the night, Raʹmah has trembled, Gibʹe·ah of Saul itself has fled.

17996.label: Isaiah 10:30
17996.text: Let your voice out in shrill cries, O daughter of Galʹlim. Pay attention, O Laʹi·shah. O you afflicted one, Anʹa·thoth!

17997.label: Isaiah 10:31
17997.text: Mad·meʹnah has run away. The inhabitants of Geʹbim themselves have taken to shelter.

17998.label: Isaiah 10:32
17998.text: It is yet day in Nob to make a halt. He waves his hand [threateningly] at the mountain of the daughter of Zion, the hill of Jerusalem.

17999.label: Isaiah 10:33
17999.text: Look! The [true] Lord, Jehovah of armies, is lopping off boughs with a terrible crash; and those tall in growth are being cut down, and the high ones themselves become low.

18000.label: Isaiah 10:34
18000.text: And he has struck down the thickets of the forest with an iron tool, and by a powerful one Lebʹa·non itself will fall.

18001.label: Isaiah 11:1
18001.text: And there must go forth a twig out of the stump of Jesʹse; and out of his roots a sprout will be fruitful.

18002.label: Isaiah 11:2
18002.text: And upon him the spirit of Jehovah must settle down, the spirit of wisdom and of understanding, the spirit of counsel and of mightiness, the spirit of knowledge and of the fear of Jehovah;

18003.label: Isaiah 11:3
18003.text: and there will be enjoyment by him in the fear of Jehovah. And he will not judge by any mere appearance to his eyes, nor reprove simply according to the thing heard by his ears.

18004.label: Isaiah 11:4
18004.text: And with righteousness he must judge the lowly ones, and with uprightness he must give reproof in behalf of the meek ones of the earth. And he must strike the earth with the rod of his mouth; and with the spirit of his lips he will put the wicked one to death.

18005.label: Isaiah 11:5
18005.text: And righteousness must prove to be the belt of his hips, and faithfulness the belt of his loins.

18006.label: Isaiah 11:6
18006.text: And the wolf will actually reside for a while with the male lamb, and with the kid the leopard itself will lie down, and the calf and the maned young lion and the well-fed animal all together; and a mere little boy will be leader over them.

18007.label: Isaiah 11:7
18007.text: And the cow and the bear themselves will feed; together their young ones will lie down. And even the lion will eat straw just like the bull.

18008.label: Isaiah 11:8
18008.text: And the sucking child will certainly play upon the hole of the cobra; and upon the light aperture of a poisonous snake will a weaned child actually put his own hand.

18009.label: Isaiah 11:9
18009.text: They will not do any harm or cause any ruin in all my holy mountain; because the earth will certainly be filled with the knowledge of Jehovah as the waters are covering the very sea.

18010.label: Isaiah 11:10
18010.text: And it must occur in that day that there will be the root of Jesʹse that will be standing up as a signal for the peoples. To him even the nations will turn inquiringly, and his resting-place must become glorious.

18011.label: Isaiah 11:11
18011.text: And it must occur in that day that Jehovah will again offer his hand, a second time, to acquire the remnant of his people who will remain over from As·syrʹi·a and from Egypt and from Pathʹros and from Cush and from Eʹlam and from Shiʹnar and from Haʹmath and from the islands of the sea.

18012.label: Isaiah 11:12
18012.text: And he will certainly raise up a signal for the nations and gather the dispersed ones of Israel; and the scattered ones of Judah he will collect together from the four extremities of the earth.

18013.label: Isaiah 11:13
18013.text: And the jealousy of Eʹphra·im must depart, and even those showing hostility to Judah will be cut off. Eʹphra·im itself will not be jealous of Judah, nor will Judah show hostility toward Eʹphra·im.

18014.label: Isaiah 11:14
18014.text: And they must fly at the shoulder of the Phi·lisʹtines to the west; together they will plunder the sons of the East. Eʹdom and Moʹab will be those upon whom they will thrust out their hand, and the sons of Amʹmon will be their subjects.

18015.label: Isaiah 11:15
18015.text: And Jehovah will certainly cut off the tongue of the Egyptian sea, and wave his hand at the River in the glow of his spirit. And he must strike it in [its] seven torrents, and he will actually cause people to walk in [their] sandals.

18016.label: Isaiah 11:16
18016.text: And there must come to be a highway out of As·syrʹi·a for the remnant of his people who will remain over, just as there came to be [one] for Israel in the day of his coming up out of the land of Egypt.

18017.label: Isaiah 12:1
18017.text: And in that day you will be sure to say: “I shall thank you, O Jehovah, for [although] you got incensed at me, your anger gradually turned back, and you proceeded to comfort me.

18018.label: Isaiah 12:2
18018.text: Look! God is my salvation. I shall trust and be in no dread; for Jah Jehovah is my strength and [my] might, and he came to be the salvation of me.”

18019.label: Isaiah 12:3
18019.text: With exultation YOU people will be certain to draw water out of the springs of salvation.

18020.label: Isaiah 12:4
18020.text: And in that day YOU will certainly say: “Give thanks to Jehovah, YOU people! Call upon his name. Make known among the peoples his dealings. Make mention that his name is put on high.

18021.label: Isaiah 12:5
18021.text: Make melody to Jehovah, for he has done surpassingly. This is made known in all the earth.

18022.label: Isaiah 12:6
18022.text: “Cry out shrilly and shout for joy, O you inhabitress of Zion, for great in the midst of you is the Holy One of Israel.”

18023.label: Isaiah 13:1
18023.text: The pronouncement against Babylon that Isaiah the son of Aʹmoz saw in vision:

18024.label: Isaiah 13:2
18024.text: “Upon a mountain of bare rocks raise up a signal, YOU men. Lift up the voice to them, wave the hand, that they may come into the entrances of the nobles.

18025.label: Isaiah 13:3
18025.text: I myself have issued the command to my sanctified ones. I have also called my mighty ones for [expressing] my anger, my eminently exultant ones.

18026.label: Isaiah 13:4
18026.text: Listen! A crowd in the mountains, something like a numerous people! Listen! The uproar of kingdoms, of nations gathered together! Jehovah of armies is mustering the army of war.

18027.label: Isaiah 13:5
18027.text: They are coming from the land far away, from the extremity of the heavens, Jehovah and the weapons of his denunciation, to wreck all the earth.

18028.label: Isaiah 13:6
18028.text: “Howl, YOU people, for the day of Jehovah is near! As a despoiling from the Almighty it will come.

18029.label: Isaiah 13:7
18029.text: That is why all hands themselves will drop down, and the whole heart itself of mortal man will melt.

18030.label: Isaiah 13:8
18030.text: And people have become disturbed. Convulsions and birth pains themselves grab hold; like a woman that is giving birth they have labor pains. They look at each other in amazement. Their faces are inflamed faces.

18031.label: Isaiah 13:9
18031.text: “Look! The day of Jehovah itself is coming, cruel both with fury and with burning anger, in order to make the land an object of astonishment, and that it may annihilate [the land’s] sinners out of it.

18032.label: Isaiah 13:10
18032.text: For the very stars of the heavens and their constellations of Keʹsil will not flash forth their light; the sun will actually grow dark at its going forth, and the moon itself will not cause its light to shine.

18033.label: Isaiah 13:11
18033.text: And I shall certainly bring home [its own] badness upon the productive land, and their own error upon the wicked themselves. And I shall actually cause the pride of the presumptuous ones to cease, and the haughtiness of the tyrants I shall abase.

18034.label: Isaiah 13:12
18034.text: I shall make mortal man rarer than refined gold, and earthling man [rarer] than the gold of Oʹphir.

18035.label: Isaiah 13:13
18035.text: That is why I shall cause heaven itself to become agitated, and the earth will rock out of its place at the fury of Jehovah of armies and at the day of his burning anger.

18036.label: Isaiah 13:14
18036.text: And it must occur that, like a gazelle chased away and like a flock without anyone to collect them together, they will turn, each one to his own people; and they will flee, each one to his own land.

18037.label: Isaiah 13:15
18037.text: Every one that is found will be pierced through, and every one that is caught in the sweep will fall by the sword;

18038.label: Isaiah 13:16
18038.text: and their very children will be dashed to pieces before their eyes. Their houses will be pillaged, and their own wives will be raped.

18039.label: Isaiah 13:17
18039.text: “Here I am arousing against them the Medes, who account silver itself as nothing and who, as respects gold, take no delight in it.

18040.label: Isaiah 13:18
18040.text: And [their] bows will dash even young men to pieces. And the fruitage of the belly they will not pity; for sons their eye will not feel sorry.

18041.label: Isaiah 13:19
18041.text: And Babylon, the decoration of kingdoms, the beauty of the pride of the Chal·deʹans, must become as when God overthrew Sodʹom and Go·morʹrah.

18042.label: Isaiah 13:20
18042.text: She will never be inhabited, nor will she reside for generation after generation. And there the Arab will not pitch his tent, and no shepherds will let [their flocks] lie down there.

18043.label: Isaiah 13:21
18043.text: And there the haunters of waterless regions will certainly lie down, and their houses must be filled with eagle owls. And there the ostriches must reside, and goat-shaped demons themselves will go skipping about there.

18044.label: Isaiah 13:22
18044.text: And jackals must howl in her dwelling towers, and the big snake will be in the palaces of exquisite delight. And the season for her is near to come, and her days themselves will not be postponed.”

18045.label: Isaiah 14:1
18045.text: For Jehovah will show mercy to Jacob, and he is yet certain to choose Israel; and he will actually give them rest upon their soil, and the alien resident must be joined to them, and they must attach themselves to the house of Jacob.

18046.label: Isaiah 14:2
18046.text: And peoples will actually take them and bring them to their own place, and the house of Israel must take them to themselves as a possession upon the soil of Jehovah as menservants and as maidservants; and they must become the captors of those holding them captive, and they must have in subjection those who were driving them to work.

18047.label: Isaiah 14:3
18047.text: And it must occur in the day when Jehovah gives you rest from your pain and from your agitation and from the hard slavery in which you were made a slave,

18048.label: Isaiah 14:4
18048.text: that you must raise up this proverbial saying against the king of Babylon and say: “How has the one driving [others] to work come to a stop, the oppression come to a stop!

18049.label: Isaiah 14:5
18049.text: Jehovah has broken the rod of the wicked ones, the staff of the ruling ones,

18050.label: Isaiah 14:6
18050.text: the one striking peoples in fury with a stroke incessantly, the one subduing nations in sheer anger with a persecution without restraint.

18051.label: Isaiah 14:7
18051.text: The whole earth has come to rest, has become free of disturbance. People have become cheerful with joyful cries.

18052.label: Isaiah 14:8
18052.text: Even the juniper trees have also rejoiced at you, the cedars of Lebʹa·non, [saying,] ‘Ever since you have lain down, no [wood]cutter comes up against us.’

18053.label: Isaiah 14:9
18053.text: “Even Sheʹol underneath has become agitated at you in order to meet you on coming in. At you it has awakened those impotent in death, all the goatlike leaders of the earth. It has made all the kings of the nations get up from their thrones.

18054.label: Isaiah 14:10
18054.text: All of them speak up and say to you, ‘Have you yourself also been made weak like us? Is it to us that you have been made comparable?

18055.label: Isaiah 14:11
18055.text: Down to Sheʹol your pride has been brought, the din of your stringed instruments. Beneath you, maggots are spread out as a couch; and worms are your covering.’

18056.label: Isaiah 14:12
18056.text: “O how you have fallen from heaven, you shining one, son of the dawn! How you have been cut down to the earth, you who were disabling the nations!

18057.label: Isaiah 14:13
18057.text: As for you, you have said in your heart, ‘To the heavens I shall go up. Above the stars of God I shall lift up my throne, and I shall sit down upon the mountain of meeting, in the remotest parts of the north.

18058.label: Isaiah 14:14
18058.text: I shall go up above the high places of the clouds; I shall make myself resemble the Most High.’

18059.label: Isaiah 14:15
18059.text: “However, down to Sheʹol you will be brought, to the remotest parts of the pit.

18060.label: Isaiah 14:16
18060.text: Those seeing you will gaze even at you; they will give close examination even to you, [saying,] ‘Is this the man that was agitating the earth, that was making kingdoms rock,

18061.label: Isaiah 14:17
18061.text: that made the productive land like the wilderness and that overthrew its very cities, that did not open the way homeward even for his prisoners?’

18062.label: Isaiah 14:18
18062.text: All other kings of the nations, yes, all of them, have lain down in glory, each one in his own house.

18063.label: Isaiah 14:19
18063.text: But as for you, you have been thrown away without a burial place for you, like a detested sprout, clothed with killed men stabbed with the sword that are going down to the stones of a pit, like a carcass trodden down.

18064.label: Isaiah 14:20
18064.text: You will not become united with them in a grave, because you brought your own land to ruin, you killed your own people. To time indefinite the offspring of evildoers will not be named.

18065.label: Isaiah 14:21
18065.text: “Make ready, YOU men, a slaughtering block for his own sons because of the error of their forefathers, that they may not rise up and actually take possession of the earth and fill the face of the productive land with cities.”

18066.label: Isaiah 14:22
18066.text: “And I will rise up against them,” is the utterance of Jehovah of armies. “And I will cut off from Babylon name and remnant and progeny and posterity,” is the utterance of Jehovah.

18067.label: Isaiah 14:23
18067.text: “And I will make her a possession of porcupines and reedy pools of water, and I will sweep her with the broom of annihilation,” is the utterance of Jehovah of armies.

18068.label: Isaiah 14:24
18068.text: Jehovah of armies has sworn, saying: “Surely just as I have figured, so it must occur; and just as I have counseled, that is what will come true,

18069.label: Isaiah 14:25
18069.text: in order to break the As·syrʹi·an in my land and that I may tread him down on my own mountains; and that his yoke may actually depart from upon them and that his very load may depart from upon their shoulder.”

18070.label: Isaiah 14:26
18070.text: This is the counsel that is counseled against all the earth, and this is the hand that is stretched out against all the nations.

18071.label: Isaiah 14:27
18071.text: For Jehovah of armies himself has counseled, and who can break [it] up? And his hand is the one stretched out, and who can turn it back?

18072.label: Isaiah 14:28
18072.text: In the year that King Aʹhaz died this pronouncement occurred:

18073.label: Isaiah 14:29
18073.text: “Do not rejoice, O Phi·lisʹti·a, any one of you, just because the staff of the one striking you has been broken. For out of the root of the serpent there will come forth a poisonous snake, and its fruit will be a flying fiery snake.

18074.label: Isaiah 14:30
18074.text: And the firstborn ones of the lowly ones will certainly feed, and in security the poor ones themselves will lie down. And with famine I will put your root to death, and what remains over of you will be killed.

18075.label: Isaiah 14:31
18075.text: Howl, O gate! Cry out, O city! All of you must become disheartened, O Phi·lisʹti·a! For out of the north a smoke is coming, and there is no one getting isolated from his ranks.”

18076.label: Isaiah 14:32
18076.text: And what will anyone say in answer to the messengers of the nation? That Jehovah himself has laid the foundation of Zion, and in her the afflicted ones of his people will take refuge.

18077.label: Isaiah 15:1
18077.text: The pronouncement against Moʹab: Because in the night it has been despoiled, Ar of Moʹab itself has been silenced. Because in the night it has been despoiled, Kir of Moʹab itself has been silenced.

18078.label: Isaiah 15:2
18078.text: He has gone up to The House and to Diʹbon, to the high places, to a weeping. Over Neʹbo and over Medʹe·ba Moʹab itself howls. On all heads in it there is baldness; every beard is clipped.

18079.label: Isaiah 15:3
18079.text: In its streets they have girded on sackcloth. Upon the roofs thereof and in the public squares thereof everyone thereof howls, going down with weeping.

18080.label: Isaiah 15:4
18080.text: And Heshʹbon and E·le·aʹleh cry out. As far as Jaʹhaz their voice has been heard. That is why the armed men of Moʹab themselves keep shouting. His very soul has quivered within him.

18081.label: Isaiah 15:5
18081.text: My own heart cries out over Moʹab himself. The runaways thereof are as far along as Zoʹar [and] Egʹlath-she·liʹshi·yah. For on the ascent of Luʹhith —with weeping [each] one goes up on it; for on the way to Hor·o·naʹim they arouse the outcry about the catastrophe.

18082.label: Isaiah 15:6
18082.text: For the very waters of Nimʹrim become sheer desolations. For the green grass has dried up, the grass has come to an end; nothing has become green.

18083.label: Isaiah 15:7
18083.text: That is why the leftovers and their stored goods that they have put up, they keep carrying them away right over the torrent valley of the poplars.

18084.label: Isaiah 15:8
18084.text: For the outcry has gone around the territory of Moʹab. The howling thereof is clear to Eg·laʹim; the howling thereof is clear to Beʹer-eʹlim,

18085.label: Isaiah 15:9
18085.text: because the very waters of Diʹmon have become full of blood. For upon Diʹmon I shall place additional things, such as a lion for the escapees of Moʹab who escape and for the remaining ones of the ground.

18086.label: Isaiah 16:1
18086.text: Send a ram, YOU men, to the ruler of the land, from Seʹla toward the wilderness, to the mountain of the daughter of Zion.

18087.label: Isaiah 16:2
18087.text: And it must occur [that] like a fleeing winged creature, chased away from [its] nest, the daughters of Moʹab will become at the fords of Arʹnon.

18088.label: Isaiah 16:3
18088.text: “Bring in counsel, YOU men, execute the decision. “Make your shadow just like the night in the midst of noontime. Conceal the dispersed ones; do not betray anyone fleeing.

18089.label: Isaiah 16:4
18089.text: May my dispersed ones reside as aliens even in you, O Moʹab. Become a place of concealment to them because of the despoiler. For the oppressor has reached his end; the despoiling has terminated; those trampling down [others] have been finished off the earth.

18090.label: Isaiah 16:5
18090.text: “And in loving-kindness a throne will certainly be firmly established; and one must sit down upon it in trueness in the tent of David, judging and seeking justice and being prompt in righteousness.”

18091.label: Isaiah 16:6
18091.text: We have heard of the pride of Moʹab, that he is very proud; his haughtiness and his pride and his fury —his empty talk will not be so.

18092.label: Isaiah 16:7
18092.text: Therefore Moʹab will howl for Moʹab; even all of it will howl. For the raisin cakes of Kir-harʹe·seth the stricken ones indeed will moan,

18093.label: Isaiah 16:8
18093.text: because the terraces themselves of Heshʹbon have withered. The vine of Sibʹmah —the owners of the nations themselves have smitten down its bright-red [branches]. As far as Jaʹzer they had reached; they had wandered about in the wilderness. Its own shoots had been left to luxuriate for themselves; they had gone over to the sea.

18094.label: Isaiah 16:9
18094.text: That is why I shall weep with the weeping of Jaʹzer over the vine of Sibʹmah. With my tears I shall drench you, O Heshʹbon and E·le·aʹleh, because shouting even over your summer and over your harvest has fallen down.

18095.label: Isaiah 16:10
18095.text: And rejoicing and joyfulness have been taken away from the orchard; and in the vineyards there is no joyful crying out, there is no shouting done. No wine in the presses does the treader tread out. Shouting I have caused to cease.

18096.label: Isaiah 16:11
18096.text: That is why my very inwards are boisterous just like a harp even over Moʹab, and the midst of me over Kir-harʹe·seth.

18097.label: Isaiah 16:12
18097.text: And it occurred that it was seen that Moʹab was made weary upon the high place; and he came to his sanctuary to pray, and he could not accomplish anything.

18098.label: Isaiah 16:13
18098.text: This is the word that Jehovah spoke concerning Moʹab formerly.

18099.label: Isaiah 16:14
18099.text: And now Jehovah has spoken, saying: “Within three years, according to the years of a hired laborer, the glory of Moʹab must also be disgraced with much commotion of every sort, and those who remain over will be a trifling few, not mighty.”

18100.label: Isaiah 17:1
18100.text: The pronouncement against Damascus: “Look! Damascus removed from being a city, and she has become a heap, a decaying ruin.

18101.label: Isaiah 17:2
18101.text: The cities of A·roʹer that have been left behind become mere places for droves, where they actually lie down, with no one to make [them] tremble.

18102.label: Isaiah 17:3
18102.text: And the fortified city has been made to cease out of Eʹphra·im, and the kingdom out of Damascus; and those of Syria remaining over will become just like the glory of the sons of Israel,” is the utterance of Jehovah of armies.

18103.label: Isaiah 17:4
18103.text: “And it must occur in that day that the glory of Jacob will become lowly, and even the fatness of his flesh will be made lean.

18104.label: Isaiah 17:5
18104.text: And it must occur that when the harvester is gathering the standing grain and his own arm harvests the ears of grain, he must even become like one gleaning ears of grain in the low plain of Rephʹa·im.

18105.label: Isaiah 17:6
18105.text: And there must remain in it a gleaning as when there is a beating off of the olive tree: two [or] three ripe olives in the top of the branch; four [or] five on the fruit-bearing boughs thereof,” is the utterance of Jehovah the God of Israel.

18106.label: Isaiah 17:7
18106.text: In that day earthling man will look up to his Maker, and his own eyes will gaze at the Holy One of Israel himself.

18107.label: Isaiah 17:8
18107.text: And he will not look to the altars, the work of his hands; and at what his fingers have made he will not gaze, either at the sacred poles or at the incense stands.

18108.label: Isaiah 17:9
18108.text: In that day his fortress cities will become like a place left entirely in the woodland, even the branch that they have left entirely on account of the sons of Israel; and it must become a desolate waste.

18109.label: Isaiah 17:10
18109.text: For you have forgotten the God of your salvation; and the Rock of your fortress you have not remembered. That is why you plant pleasant plantations, and with the shoot of a stranger you set it.

18110.label: Isaiah 17:11
18110.text: In the day you may carefully fence about the plantation of yours, and in the morning you may cause the seed of yours to sprout, [but] the harvest will certainly flee in the day of the disease and incurable pain.

18111.label: Isaiah 17:12
18111.text: Ha for the commotion of many peoples, who are boisterous as with the boisterousness of the seas! And for the noise of national groups, who make a din just like the noise of mighty waters!

18112.label: Isaiah 17:13
18112.text: The national groups themselves will make a din just like the noise of many waters. And He will certainly rebuke it, and it must flee far away and be chased like the chaff of the mountains before a wind and like a thistle whirl before a storm wind.

18113.label: Isaiah 17:14
18113.text: At evening time, why, look! there is sudden terror. Before morning—it is no more. This is the share of those pillaging us, and the lot belonging to those plundering us.

18114.label: Isaiah 18:1
18114.text: Ha for the land of the whirring insects with wings, which is in the region of the rivers of E·thi·oʹpi·a!

18115.label: Isaiah 18:2
18115.text: It is the one sending forth envoys by means of the sea, and by means of vessels of papyrus upon the surface of the waters, [saying:] “Go, YOU swift messengers, to a nation drawn out and scoured, to a people fear-inspiring everywhere, a nation of tensile strength and of treading down, whose land the rivers have washed away.”

18116.label: Isaiah 18:3
18116.text: All YOU inhabitants of the productive land and YOU residents of the earth, YOU will see a sight just as when there is the raising up of a signal upon the mountains, and YOU will hear a sound just as when there is the blowing of a horn.

18117.label: Isaiah 18:4
18117.text: For this is what Jehovah has said to me: “I will keep undisturbed and look upon my established place, like the dazzling heat along with the light, like the cloud of dew in the heat of harvest.

18118.label: Isaiah 18:5
18118.text: For before the harvest, when the blossom comes to perfection and the bloom becomes a ripening grape, one must also cut off the sprigs with pruning shears and must remove the tendrils, must lop [them] off.

18119.label: Isaiah 18:6
18119.text: They will be left all together for the bird of prey of the mountains and for the beast of the earth. And upon it the bird of prey will certainly pass the summer, and upon it even every beast of the earth will pass the harvesttime.

18120.label: Isaiah 18:7
18120.text: “In that time a gift will be brought to Jehovah of armies, [from] a people drawn out and scoured, even from a people fear-inspiring everywhere, a nation of tensile strength and of treading down, whose land the rivers have washed away, to the place of the name of Jehovah of armies, Mount Zion.”

18121.label: Isaiah 19:1
18121.text: The pronouncement against Egypt: Look! Jehovah is riding on a swift cloud and coming into Egypt. And the valueless gods of Egypt will certainly quiver because of him, and the very heart of Egypt will melt in the midst of it.

18122.label: Isaiah 19:2
18122.text: “And I will goad Egyptians against Egyptians, and they will certainly war each one against his brother, and each one against his companion, city against city, kingdom against kingdom.

18123.label: Isaiah 19:3
18123.text: And the spirit of Egypt must become bewildered in the midst of it, and I shall confuse its own counsel. And they will be certain to resort to the valueless gods and to the charmers and to the spirit mediums and to the professional foretellers of events.

18124.label: Isaiah 19:4
18124.text: And I will deliver up Egypt into the hand of a hard master, and strong will be the king that will rule over them,” is the utterance of the [true] Lord, Jehovah of armies.

18125.label: Isaiah 19:5
18125.text: And the water will certainly be dried up from the sea, and the river itself will become parched and actually run dry.

18126.label: Isaiah 19:6
18126.text: And the rivers must stink; the Nile canals of Egypt must become low and parched. The reed and the rush themselves must molder.

18127.label: Isaiah 19:7
18127.text: The bare places by the Nile River, at the mouth of the Nile River, and every seedland of the Nile River will dry up. It will certainly be driven away, and it will be no more.

18128.label: Isaiah 19:8
18128.text: And the fishers will have to mourn, and all those casting fishhooks into the Nile River must express sorrow, and even those spreading fishing nets upon the surface of the water will actually fade away.

18129.label: Isaiah 19:9
18129.text: And the workers in carded flax must become ashamed; also the loom workers on white fabrics.

18130.label: Isaiah 19:10
18130.text: And her weavers must become crushed, all the wage workers grieved in soul.

18131.label: Isaiah 19:11
18131.text: The princes of Zoʹan are indeed foolish. As regards the wise ones of Pharʹaoh’s counselors, [their] counsel is something unreasonable. How will YOU men say to Pharʹaoh: “I am the son of wise ones, the son of kings of ancient time”?

18132.label: Isaiah 19:12
18132.text: Where, then, are they—the wise men of yours —that they may now tell you and that they may know what Jehovah of armies has counseled concerning Egypt?

18133.label: Isaiah 19:13
18133.text: The princes of Zoʹan have acted foolishly, the princes of Noph have been deceived, the keymen of her tribes have caused Egypt to wander about.

18134.label: Isaiah 19:14
18134.text: Jehovah himself has mingled in the midst of her the spirit of disconcertedness; and they have caused Egypt to wander about in all its work, just as someone drunk is made to wander about in his vomit.

18135.label: Isaiah 19:15
18135.text: And Egypt will not come to have any work that the head or the tail, the shoot or the rush, can do.

18136.label: Isaiah 19:16
18136.text: In that day Egypt will become like women, and it will certainly tremble and be in dread because of the waving of the hand of Jehovah of armies which he is waving against it.

18137.label: Isaiah 19:17
18137.text: And the ground of Judah must become to Egypt a cause for reeling. Everybody to whom one mentions it is in dread because of the counsel of Jehovah of armies that he is counseling against him.

18138.label: Isaiah 19:18
18138.text: In that day there will prove to be five cities in the land of Egypt speaking the language of Caʹnaan and swearing to Jehovah of armies. The City of Tearing Down will one [city] be called.

18139.label: Isaiah 19:19
18139.text: In that day there will prove to be an altar to Jehovah in the midst of the land of Egypt, and a pillar to Jehovah beside its boundary.

18140.label: Isaiah 19:20
18140.text: And it must prove to be for a sign and for a witness to Jehovah of armies in the land of Egypt; for they will cry out to Jehovah because of the oppressors, and he will send them a savior, even a grand one, who will actually deliver them.

18141.label: Isaiah 19:21
18141.text: And Jehovah will certainly become known to the Egyptians; and the Egyptians must know Jehovah in that day, and they must render sacrifice and gift and must make a vow to Jehovah and pay it.

18142.label: Isaiah 19:22
18142.text: And Jehovah will certainly deal Egypt a blow. There will be a dealing of a blow and a healing; and they must return to Jehovah, and he must let himself be entreated by them and must heal them.

18143.label: Isaiah 19:23
18143.text: In that day there will come to be a highway out of Egypt to As·syrʹi·a, and As·syrʹi·a will actually come into Egypt, and Egypt into As·syrʹi·a; and they will certainly render service, Egypt with As·syrʹi·a.

18144.label: Isaiah 19:24
18144.text: In that day Israel will come to be the third with Egypt and with As·syrʹi·a, namely, a blessing in the midst of the earth,

18145.label: Isaiah 19:25
18145.text: because Jehovah of armies will have blessed it, saying: “Blessed be my people, Egypt, and the work of my hands, As·syrʹi·a, and my inheritance, Israel.”

18146.label: Isaiah 20:1
18146.text: In the year that Tarʹtan came to Ashʹdod, when Sarʹgon the king of As·syrʹi·a sent him, and he proceeded to war against Ashʹdod and to capture it;

18147.label: Isaiah 20:2
18147.text: at that time Jehovah spoke by the hand of Isaiah the son of Aʹmoz, saying: “Go, and you must loosen the sackcloth from off your hips; and your sandals you should draw from off your feet.” And he proceeded to do so, walking about naked and barefoot.

18148.label: Isaiah 20:3
18148.text: And Jehovah went on to say: “Just as my servant Isaiah has walked about naked and barefoot three years as a sign and a portent against Egypt and against E·thi·oʹpi·a,

18149.label: Isaiah 20:4
18149.text: so the king of As·syrʹi·a will lead the body of captives of Egypt and the exiles of E·thi·oʹpi·a, boys and old men, naked and barefoot, and with buttocks stripped, the nakedness of Egypt.

18150.label: Isaiah 20:5
18150.text: And they will certainly be terrified and be ashamed of E·thi·oʹpi·a their looked-for hope and of Egypt their beauty.

18151.label: Isaiah 20:6
18151.text: And the inhabitant of this coastland will be certain to say in that day, ‘There is how our looked-for hope is, to which we fled for assistance, in order to be delivered because of the king of As·syrʹi·a! And how shall we ourselves escape?’”

18152.label: Isaiah 21:1
18152.text: The pronouncement against the wilderness of the sea: Like storm winds in the south in moving onward, from the wilderness it is coming, from a fear-inspiring land.

18153.label: Isaiah 21:2
18153.text: There is a hard vision that has been told to me: The treacherous dealer is dealing treacherously, and the despoiler is despoiling. Go up, O Eʹlam! Lay siege, O Meʹdi·a! All sighing due to her I have caused to cease.

18154.label: Isaiah 21:3
18154.text: That is why my hips have become full of severe pains. Convulsions themselves have grabbed hold of me, like the convulsions of a woman that is giving birth. I have become disconcerted so that I do not hear; I have become disturbed so that I do not see.

18155.label: Isaiah 21:4
18155.text: My heart has wandered about; a shuddering itself has terrified me. The twilight for which I had an attachment has been made for me a trembling.

18156.label: Isaiah 21:5
18156.text: Let there be a setting of the table in order, an arranging of the location of seats, an eating, a drinking! Get up, YOU princes, anoint the shield.

18157.label: Isaiah 21:6
18157.text: For this is what Jehovah has said to me: “Go, post a lookout that he may tell just what he sees.”

18158.label: Isaiah 21:7
18158.text: And he saw a war chariot [with] a span of steeds, a war chariot of asses, a war chariot of camels. And he paid strict attention, with much attentiveness.

18159.label: Isaiah 21:8
