18537.text: “COMFORT, comfort my people,” says the God of YOU men.

18538.label: Isaiah 40:2
18538.text: “SPEAK to the heart of Jerusalem and call out to her that her military service has been fulfilled, that her error has been paid off. For from the hand of Jehovah she has received a full amount for all her sins.”

18539.label: Isaiah 40:3
18539.text: Listen! Someone is calling out in the wilderness: “Clear up the way of Jehovah, YOU people! MAKE the highway for our God through the desert plain straight.

18540.label: Isaiah 40:4
18540.text: Let every valley be raised up, and every mountain and hill be made low. And the knobby ground must become level land, and the rugged ground a valley plain.

18541.label: Isaiah 40:5
18541.text: And the glory of Jehovah will certainly be revealed, and all flesh must see [it] together, for the very mouth of Jehovah has spoken [it].”

18542.label: Isaiah 40:6
18542.text: Listen! Someone is saying: “Call out!” And one said: “What shall I call out?” “All flesh is green grass, and all their loving-kindness is like the blossom of the field.

18543.label: Isaiah 40:7
18543.text: The green grass has dried up, the blossom has withered, because the very spirit of Jehovah has blown upon it. Surely the people are green grass.

18544.label: Isaiah 40:8
18544.text: The green grass has dried up, the blossom has withered; but as for the word of our God, it will last to time indefinite.”

18545.label: Isaiah 40:9
18545.text: Make your way up even onto a high mountain, you woman bringing good news for Zion. Raise your voice even with power, you woman bringing good news for Jerusalem. Raise [it]. Do not be afraid. Say to the cities of Judah: “Here is YOUR God.”

18546.label: Isaiah 40:10
18546.text: Look! The Sovereign Lord Jehovah himself will come even as a strong one, and his arm will be ruling for him. Look! His reward is with him, and the wage he pays is before him.

18547.label: Isaiah 40:11
18547.text: Like a shepherd he will shepherd his own drove. With his arm he will collect together the lambs; and in his bosom he will carry [them]. Those giving suck he will conduct [with care].

18548.label: Isaiah 40:12
18548.text: Who has measured the waters in the mere hollow of his hand, and taken the proportions of the heavens themselves with a mere span and included in a measure the dust of the earth, or weighed with an indicator the mountains, and the hills in the scales?

18549.label: Isaiah 40:13
18549.text: Who has taken the proportions of the spirit of Jehovah, and who as his man of counsel can make him know anything?

18550.label: Isaiah 40:14
18550.text: With whom did he consult together that one might make him understand, or who teaches him in the path of justice, or teaches him knowledge, or makes him know the very way of real understanding?

18551.label: Isaiah 40:15
18551.text: Look! The nations are as a drop from a bucket; and as the film of dust on the scales they have been accounted. Look! He lifts the islands themselves as mere fine [dust].

18552.label: Isaiah 40:16
18552.text: Even Lebʹa·non is not sufficient for keeping a fire burning, and its wild animals are not sufficient for a burnt offering.

18553.label: Isaiah 40:17
18553.text: All the nations are as something nonexistent in front of him; as nothing and an unreality they have been accounted to him.

18554.label: Isaiah 40:18
18554.text: And to whom can YOU people liken God, and what likeness can YOU put alongside him?

18555.label: Isaiah 40:19
18555.text: The craftsman has cast a mere molten image, and with gold the metalworker overlays it, and silver chains he is forging.

18556.label: Isaiah 40:20
18556.text: A certain tree as a contribution, a tree that is not rotten, he chooses. A skillful craftsman he searches out for himself, to prepare a carved image that may not be made to totter.

18557.label: Isaiah 40:21
18557.text: Do YOU people not know? Do YOU not hear? Has it not been told to YOU from the outset? Have YOU not applied understanding from the foundations of the earth?

18558.label: Isaiah 40:22
18558.text: There is One who is dwelling above the circle of the earth, the dwellers in which are as grasshoppers, the One who is stretching out the heavens just as a fine gauze, who spreads them out like a tent in which to dwell,

18559.label: Isaiah 40:23
18559.text: the One who is reducing high officials to nothing, who has made the very judges of the earth as a mere unreality.

18560.label: Isaiah 40:24
18560.text: Never yet have they been planted; never yet have they been sown; never yet has their stump taken root in the earth. And one has only to blow upon them and they dry up; and like stubble the windstorm itself will carry them away.

18561.label: Isaiah 40:25
18561.text: “But to whom can YOU people liken me so that I should be made his equal?” says the Holy One.

18562.label: Isaiah 40:26
18562.text: “Raise YOUR eyes high up and see. Who has created these things? It is the One who is bringing forth the army of them even by number, all of whom he calls even by name. Due to the abundance of dynamic energy, he also being vigorous in power, not one [of them] is missing.

18563.label: Isaiah 40:27
18563.text: “For what reason do you say, O Jacob, and do you speak out, O Israel, ‘My way has been concealed from Jehovah, and justice to me eludes my God himself’?

18564.label: Isaiah 40:28
18564.text: Have you not come to know or have you not heard? Jehovah, the Creator of the extremities of the earth, is a God to time indefinite. He does not tire out or grow weary. There is no searching out of his understanding.

18565.label: Isaiah 40:29
18565.text: He is giving to the tired one power; and to the one without dynamic energy he makes full might abound.

18566.label: Isaiah 40:30
18566.text: Boys will both tire out and grow weary, and young men themselves will without fail stumble,

18567.label: Isaiah 40:31
18567.text: but those who are hoping in Jehovah will regain power. They will mount up with wings like eagles. They will run and not grow weary; they will walk and not tire out.”

18568.label: Isaiah 41:1
18568.text: “Attend to me in silence, YOU islands; and let national groups themselves regain power. Let them approach. At that time let them speak. Let us come up close together for the judgment itself.

18569.label: Isaiah 41:2
18569.text: “Who has roused up [someone] from the sunrise? [Who] proceeded in righteousness to call him to His feet, to give before him the nations, and to make [him] go subduing even kings? [Who] kept giving [them] like dust to his sword, so that they have been driven about like mere stubble with his bow?

18570.label: Isaiah 41:3
18570.text: [Who] kept pursuing them, kept peacefully passing along on his feet over the path [by which] he did not proceed to come?

18571.label: Isaiah 41:4
18571.text: Who has been active and has done [this], calling out the generations from the start? “I, Jehovah, the First One; and with the last ones I am the same.”

18572.label: Isaiah 41:5
18572.text: The islands saw and began to fear. The very extremities of the earth began trembling. They drew near and kept coming.

18573.label: Isaiah 41:6
18573.text: They went helping each one his companion, and one would say to his brother: “Be strong.”

18574.label: Isaiah 41:7
18574.text: So the craftsman went strengthening the metalworker; the one doing the smoothing out with the forge hammer him that is hammering away at the anvil, saying regarding the soldering: “It is good.” Finally one fastened it with nails that it could not be made to totter.

18575.label: Isaiah 41:8
18575.text: “But you, O Israel, are my servant, you, O Jacob, whom I have chosen, the seed of Abraham my friend;

18576.label: Isaiah 41:9
18576.text: you, whom I have taken hold of from the extremities of the earth, and you, whom I have called even from the remote parts of it. And so I said to you, ‘You are my servant; I have chosen you, and I have not rejected you.

18577.label: Isaiah 41:10
18577.text: Do not be afraid, for I am with you. Do not gaze about, for I am your God. I will fortify you. I will really help you. I will really keep fast hold of you with my right hand of righteousness.’

18578.label: Isaiah 41:11
18578.text: “Look! All those getting heated up against you will become ashamed and be humiliated. The men in a quarrel with you will become as nothing and will perish.

18579.label: Isaiah 41:12
18579.text: You will search for them, but you will not find them, those men in a struggle with you. They will become as something nonexistent and as nothing, those men at war with you.

18580.label: Isaiah 41:13
18580.text: For I, Jehovah your God, am grasping your right hand, the One saying to you, ‘Do not be afraid. I myself will help you.’

18581.label: Isaiah 41:14
18581.text: “Do not be afraid, you worm Jacob, YOU men of Israel. I myself will help you,” is the utterance of Jehovah, even your Repurchaser, the Holy One of Israel.

18582.label: Isaiah 41:15
18582.text: “Look! I have made you a threshing sledge, a new threshing instrument having double-edged [teeth]. You will tread down the mountains and crush [them]; and the hills you will make just like the chaff.

18583.label: Isaiah 41:16
18583.text: You will winnow them, and a wind itself will carry them away, and a windstorm itself will drive them different ways. And you yourself will be joyful in Jehovah. In the Holy One of Israel you will boast about yourself.”

18584.label: Isaiah 41:17
18584.text: “The afflicted ones and the poor ones are seeking for water, but there is none. Because of thirst their very tongue has become dry. I myself, Jehovah, shall answer them. I, the God of Israel, shall not leave them.

18585.label: Isaiah 41:18
18585.text: Upon bare hills I shall open up rivers, and in the midst of the valley plains, springs. I shall make the wilderness into a reedy pool of water, and the waterless land into sources of water.

18586.label: Isaiah 41:19
18586.text: In the wilderness I shall set the cedar tree, the acacia and the myrtle and the oil tree. In the desert plain I shall place the juniper tree, the ash and the cypress at the same time;

18587.label: Isaiah 41:20
18587.text: in order that people may see and know and pay heed and have insight at the same time, that the very hand of Jehovah has done this, and the Holy One of Israel has himself created it.”

18588.label: Isaiah 41:21
18588.text: “Bring YOUR controversial case forward,” says Jehovah. “Produce YOUR arguments,” says the King of Jacob.

18589.label: Isaiah 41:22
18589.text: “Produce and tell to us the things that are going to happen. The first things—what they were—do tell, that we may apply our heart and know the future of them. Or cause us to hear even the things that are coming.

18590.label: Isaiah 41:23
18590.text: Tell the things that are to come afterward, that we may know that YOU are gods. Yes, YOU ought to do good or do bad, that we may gaze about and see [it] at the same time.

18591.label: Isaiah 41:24
18591.text: Look! YOU are something nonexistent, and YOUR achievement is nothing. A detestable thing is anyone that chooses YOU.

18592.label: Isaiah 41:25
18592.text: “I have roused up [someone] from the north, and he will come. From the rising of the sun he will call upon my name. And he will come upon deputy rulers as [if they were] clay and just as a potter that tramples down the moist material.

18593.label: Isaiah 41:26
18593.text: “Who has told anything from the start, that we may know, or from times past, that we may say, ‘He is right’? Really there is no one telling. Really there is no one causing [one] to hear. Really there is no one that is hearing any sayings of YOU men.”

18594.label: Isaiah 41:27
18594.text: There is one first, [saying] to Zion: “Look! Here they are!” and to Jerusalem I shall give a bringer of good news.

18595.label: Isaiah 41:28
18595.text: And I kept seeing, and there was not a man; and out of these there was also no one that was giving counsel. And I kept asking them, that they might make a reply.

18596.label: Isaiah 41:29
18596.text: Look! All of them are something nonexistent. Their works are nothing. Their molten images are wind and unreality.

18597.label: Isaiah 42:1
18597.text: Look! My servant, on whom I keep fast hold! My chosen one, [whom] my soul has approved! I have put my spirit in him. Justice to the nations is what he will bring forth.

18598.label: Isaiah 42:2
18598.text: He will not cry out or raise [his voice], and in the street he will not let his voice be heard.

18599.label: Isaiah 42:3
18599.text: No crushed reed will he break; and as for a dim flaxen wick, he will not extinguish it. In trueness he will bring forth justice.

18600.label: Isaiah 42:4
18600.text: He will not grow dim nor be crushed until he sets justice in the earth itself; and for his law the islands themselves will keep waiting.

18601.label: Isaiah 42:5
18601.text: This is what the [true] God, Jehovah, has said, the Creator of the heavens and the Grand One stretching them out; the One laying out the earth and its produce, the One giving breath to the people on it, and spirit to those walking in it:

18602.label: Isaiah 42:6
18602.text: “I myself, Jehovah, have called you in righteousness, and I proceeded to take hold of your hand. And I shall safeguard you and give you as a covenant of the people, as a light of the nations,

18603.label: Isaiah 42:7
18603.text: [for you] to open the blind eyes, to bring forth out of the dungeon the prisoner, out of the house of detention those sitting in darkness.

18604.label: Isaiah 42:8
18604.text: “I am Jehovah. That is my name; and to no one else shall I give my own glory, neither my praise to graven images.

18605.label: Isaiah 42:9
18605.text: “The first things—here they have come, but new things I am telling out. Before they begin to spring up, I cause YOU people to hear [them].”

18606.label: Isaiah 42:10
18606.text: Sing to Jehovah a new song, his praise from the extremity of the earth, YOU men that are going down to the sea and to that which fills it, YOU islands and YOU inhabiting them.

18607.label: Isaiah 42:11
18607.text: Let the wilderness and its cities raise [their voice], the settlements that Keʹdar inhabits. Let the inhabitants of the crag cry out in joy. From the top of the mountains let people cry aloud.

18608.label: Isaiah 42:12
18608.text: Let them attribute to Jehovah glory, and in the islands let them tell forth even his praise.

18609.label: Isaiah 42:13
18609.text: Like a mighty man Jehovah himself will go forth. Like a warrior he will awaken zeal. He will shout, yes, he will let out a war cry; over his enemies he will show himself mightier.

18610.label: Isaiah 42:14
18610.text: “I have kept quiet for a long time. I continued silent. I kept exercising self-control. Like a woman giving birth I am going to groan, pant, and gasp at the same time.

18611.label: Isaiah 42:15
18611.text: I shall devastate mountains and hills, and all their vegetation I shall dry up. And I will turn rivers into islands, and reedy pools I shall dry up.

18612.label: Isaiah 42:16
18612.text: And I will make the blind ones walk in a way that they have not known; in a roadway that they have not known I shall cause them to tread. I shall turn a dark place before them into light, and rugged terrain into level land. These are the things that I will do for them, and I will not leave them.”

18613.label: Isaiah 42:17
18613.text: They must be turned back, they will be very much ashamed, those who are putting trust in the carved image, those who are saying to a molten image: “YOU are our gods.”

18614.label: Isaiah 42:18
18614.text: Hear, YOU deaf ones; and look forth to see, YOU blind ones.

18615.label: Isaiah 42:19
18615.text: Who is blind, if not my servant, and who is deaf as my messenger whom I send? Who is blind as the one rewarded, or blind as the servant of Jehovah?

18616.label: Isaiah 42:20
18616.text: It was a case of seeing many things, but you did not keep watching. It was a case of opening the ears, but you did not keep listening.

18617.label: Isaiah 42:21
18617.text: Jehovah himself for the sake of his righteousness has taken a delight in that he should magnify the law and make it majestic.

18618.label: Isaiah 42:22
18618.text: But it is a people plundered and pillaged, all of them being trapped in the holes, and in the houses of detention they have been kept hidden. They have come to be for plunder without a deliverer, for pillage without anyone to say: “Bring back!”

18619.label: Isaiah 42:23
18619.text: Who among YOU people will give ear to this? Who will pay attention and listen for later times?

18620.label: Isaiah 42:24
18620.text: Who has given Jacob for mere pillage, and Israel to the plunderers? Is it not Jehovah, the One against whom we have sinned, and in whose ways they did not want to walk and to whose law they did not listen?

18621.label: Isaiah 42:25
18621.text: So He kept pouring out upon him rage, his anger, and the strength of war. And it kept consuming him all around, but he took no note; and it kept blazing up against him, but he would lay nothing to heart.

18622.label: Isaiah 43:1
18622.text: And now this is what Jehovah has said, your Creator, O Jacob, and your Former, O Israel: “Do not be afraid, for I have repurchased you. I have called [you] by your name. You are mine.

18623.label: Isaiah 43:2
18623.text: In case you should pass through the waters, I will be with you; and through the rivers, they will not flood over you. In case you should walk through the fire, you will not be scorched, neither will the flame itself singe you.

18624.label: Isaiah 43:3
18624.text: For I am Jehovah your God, the Holy One of Israel your Savior. I have given Egypt as a ransom for you, E·thi·oʹpi·a and Seʹba in place of you.

18625.label: Isaiah 43:4
18625.text: Owing to the fact that you have been precious in my eyes, you have been considered honorable, and I myself have loved you. And I shall give men in place of you, and national groups in place of your soul.

18626.label: Isaiah 43:5
18626.text: “Do not be afraid, for I am with you. From the sunrising I shall bring your seed, and from the sunset I shall collect you together.

18627.label: Isaiah 43:6
18627.text: I shall say to the north, ‘Give up!’ and to the south, ‘Do not keep back. Bring my sons from far off, and my daughters from the extremity of the earth,

18628.label: Isaiah 43:7
18628.text: everyone that is called by my name and that I have created for my own glory, that I have formed, yes, that I have made.’

18629.label: Isaiah 43:8
18629.text: “Bring forth a people blind though eyes themselves exist, and the ones deaf though they have ears.

18630.label: Isaiah 43:9
18630.text: Let the nations all be collected together at one place, and let national groups be gathered together. Who is there among them that can tell this? Or can they cause us to hear even the first things? Let them furnish their witnesses, that they may be declared righteous, or let them hear and say, ‘It is the truth!’”

18631.label: Isaiah 43:10
18631.text: “YOU are my witnesses,” is the utterance of Jehovah, “even my servant whom I have chosen, in order that YOU may know and have faith in me, and that YOU may understand that I am the same One. Before me there was no God formed, and after me there continued to be none.

18632.label: Isaiah 43:11
18632.text: I—I am Jehovah, and besides me there is no savior.”

18633.label: Isaiah 43:12
18633.text: “I myself have told forth and have saved and have caused [it] to be heard, when there was among YOU no strange [god]. So YOU are my witnesses,” is the utterance of Jehovah, “and I am God.

18634.label: Isaiah 43:13
18634.text: Also, all the time I am the same One; and there is no one effecting deliverance out of my own hand. I shall get active, and who can turn it back?”

18635.label: Isaiah 43:14
18635.text: This is what Jehovah has said, the Repurchaser of YOU people, the Holy One of Israel: “For YOUR sakes I will send to Babylon and cause the bars of the prisons to come down, and the Chal·deʹans in the ships with whining cries on their part.

18636.label: Isaiah 43:15
18636.text: I am Jehovah YOUR Holy One, the Creator of Israel, YOUR King.”

18637.label: Isaiah 43:16
18637.text: This is what Jehovah has said, the One making a way through the sea itself and a roadway even through strong waters,

18638.label: Isaiah 43:17
18638.text: the One bringing forth the war chariot and the horse, the military force and the strong ones at the same time: “They will lie down. They will not get up. They will certainly be extinguished. Like a flaxen wick they must be put out.”

18639.label: Isaiah 43:18
18639.text: “Do not remember the first things, and to the former things do not turn YOUR consideration.

18640.label: Isaiah 43:19
18640.text: Look! I am doing something new. Now it will spring up. YOU people will know it, will YOU not? Really, through the wilderness I shall set a way, through the desert rivers.

18641.label: Isaiah 43:20
18641.text: The wild beast of the field will glorify me, the jackals and the ostriches; because I shall have given water even in the wilderness, rivers in the desert, to cause my people, my chosen one, to drink,

18642.label: Isaiah 43:21
18642.text: the people whom I have formed for myself, that they should recount the praise of me.

18643.label: Isaiah 43:22
18643.text: “But you have not called even me, O Jacob, because you have grown weary of me, O Israel.

18644.label: Isaiah 43:23
18644.text: You have not brought me the sheep of your whole burnt offerings, and with your sacrifices you have not glorified me. I have not compelled you to serve me with a gift, nor have I made you weary with frankincense.

18645.label: Isaiah 43:24
18645.text: For me you have bought no [sweet] cane with any money; and with the fat of your sacrifices you have not saturated me. In reality you have compelled me to serve because of your sins; you have made me weary with your errors.

18646.label: Isaiah 43:25
18646.text: “I—I am the One that is wiping out your transgressions for my own sake, and your sins I shall not remember.

18647.label: Isaiah 43:26
18647.text: Remind me; let us put ourselves on judgment together; tell your own account of it in order that you may be in the right.

18648.label: Isaiah 43:27
18648.text: Your own father, the first one, has sinned, and your own spokesmen have transgressed against me.

18649.label: Isaiah 43:28
18649.text: So I shall profane the princes of the holy place, and I will give Jacob over as a man devoted to destruction and Israel over to words of abuse.

18650.label: Isaiah 44:1
18650.text: “And now listen, O Jacob my servant, and you, O Israel, whom I have chosen.

18651.label: Isaiah 44:2
18651.text: This is what Jehovah has said, your Maker and your Former, who kept helping you even from the belly, ‘Do not be afraid, O my servant Jacob, and you, Jeshʹu·run, whom I have chosen.

18652.label: Isaiah 44:3
18652.text: For I shall pour out water upon the thirsty one, and trickling streams upon the dry place. I shall pour out my spirit upon your seed, and my blessing upon your descendants.

18653.label: Isaiah 44:4
18653.text: And they will certainly spring up as among the green grass, like poplars by the water ditches.

18654.label: Isaiah 44:5
18654.text: This one will say: “I belong to Jehovah.” And that one will call [himself] by the name of Jacob, and another will write upon his hand: “Belonging to Jehovah.” And by the name of Israel one will betitle [himself].’

18655.label: Isaiah 44:6
18655.text: “This is what Jehovah has said, the King of Israel and the Repurchaser of him, Jehovah of armies, ‘I am the first and I am the last, and besides me there is no God.

18656.label: Isaiah 44:7
18656.text: And who is there like me? Let him call out, that he may tell it and present it to me. From when I appointed the people of long ago, both the things coming and the things that will enter in let them tell on their part.

18657.label: Isaiah 44:8
18657.text: Do not be in dread, YOU people, and do not become stupefied. Have I not from that time on caused you individually to hear and told [it] out? And YOU are my witnesses. Does there exist a God besides me? No, there is no Rock. I have recognized none.’”

18658.label: Isaiah 44:9
18658.text: The formers of the carved image are all of them an unreality, and their darlings themselves will be of no benefit; and as their witnesses they see nothing and know nothing, in order that they may be ashamed.

18659.label: Isaiah 44:10
18659.text: Who has formed a god or cast a mere molten image? Of no benefit at all has it been.

18660.label: Isaiah 44:11
18660.text: Look! All his partners themselves will be ashamed, and the craftsmen are from earthling men. They will all of them collect themselves together. They will stand still. They will be in dread. They will be ashamed at the same time.

18661.label: Isaiah 44:12
18661.text: As for the carver of iron with the billhook, he has been busy [at it] with the coals; and with the hammers he proceeds to form it, and he keeps busy at it with his powerful arm. Also, he has become hungry, and so without power. He has not drunk water; so he gets tired.

18662.label: Isaiah 44:13
18662.text: As for the wood carver, he has stretched out the measuring line; he traces it out with red chalk; he works it up with a wood scraper; and with a compass he keeps tracing it out, and gradually he makes it like the representation of a man, like the beauty of mankind, to sit in a house.

18663.label: Isaiah 44:14
18663.text: There is one whose business is to cut down cedars; and he takes a certain species of tree, even a massive tree, and he lets it become strong for himself among the trees of the forest. He planted the laurel tree, and the pouring rain itself keeps making it get big.

18664.label: Isaiah 44:15
18664.text: And it has become [something] for man to keep a fire burning. So he takes part of it that he may warm himself. In fact he builds a fire and actually bakes bread. He also works on a god to which he may bow down. He has made it into a carved image, and he prostrates himself to it.

18665.label: Isaiah 44:16
18665.text: Half of it he actually burns up in a fire. Upon half of it he roasts well the flesh that he eats, and he becomes satisfied. He also warms himself and says: “Aha! I have warmed myself. I have seen the firelight.”

18666.label: Isaiah 44:17
18666.text: But the remainder of it he actually makes into a god itself, into his carved image. He prostrates himself to it and bows down and prays to it and says: “Deliver me, for you are my god.”

18667.label: Isaiah 44:18
18667.text: They have not come to know, nor do they understand, because their eyes have been besmeared so as not to see, their heart so as to have no insight.

18668.label: Isaiah 44:19
18668.text: And no one recalls to his heart or has knowledge or understanding, saying: “The half of it I have burned up in a fire, and upon its coals I have also baked bread; I roast flesh and eat. But the rest of it shall I make into a mere detestable thing? To the dried-out wood of a tree shall I prostrate myself?”

18669.label: Isaiah 44:20
18669.text: He is feeding on ashes. His own heart that has been trifled with has led him astray. And he does not deliver his soul, nor does he say: “Is there not a falsehood in my right hand?”

18670.label: Isaiah 44:21
18670.text: “Remember these things, O Jacob, and you, O Israel, because you are my servant. I have formed you. You are a servant belonging to me. O Israel, you will not be forgotten on my part.

18671.label: Isaiah 44:22
18671.text: I will wipe out your transgressions just as with a cloud, and your sins just as with a cloud mass. Do return to me, for I will repurchase you.

18672.label: Isaiah 44:23
18672.text: “Joyfully cry out, YOU heavens, for Jehovah has taken action! Shout in triumph, all YOU lowest parts of the earth! Become cheerful, YOU mountains, with joyful outcry, you forest and all YOU trees in it! For Jehovah has repurchased Jacob, and on Israel he shows his beauty.”

18673.label: Isaiah 44:24
18673.text: This is what Jehovah has said, your Repurchaser and the Former of you from the belly: “I, Jehovah, am doing everything, stretching out the heavens by myself, laying out the earth. Who was with me?

18674.label: Isaiah 44:25
18674.text: [I am] frustrating the signs of the empty talkers, and [I am] the One that makes diviners themselves act crazily; the One turning wise men backwards, and the One that turns even their knowledge into foolishness;

18675.label: Isaiah 44:26
18675.text: the One making the word of his servant come true, and the One that carries out completely the counsel of his own messengers; the One saying of Jerusalem, ‘She will be inhabited,’ and of the cities of Judah, ‘They will be rebuilt, and her desolated places I shall raise up’;

18676.label: Isaiah 44:27
18676.text: the One saying to the watery deep, ‘Be evaporated; and all your rivers I shall dry up’;

18677.label: Isaiah 44:28
18677.text: the One saying of Cyrus, ‘He is my shepherd, and all that I delight in he will completely carry out’; even in [my] saying of Jerusalem, ‘She will be rebuilt,’ and of the temple, ‘You will have your foundation laid.’”

18678.label: Isaiah 45:1
18678.text: This is what Jehovah has said to his anointed one, to Cyrus, whose right hand I have taken hold of, to subdue before him nations, so that I may ungird even the hips of kings; to open before him the two-leaved doors, so that even the gates will not be shut:

18679.label: Isaiah 45:2
18679.text: “Before you I myself shall go, and the swells of land I shall straighten out. The copper doors I shall break in pieces, and the iron bars I shall cut down.

18680.label: Isaiah 45:3
18680.text: And I will give you the treasures in the darkness and the hidden treasures in the concealment places, in order that you may know that I am Jehovah, the One calling [you] by your name, the God of Israel.

18681.label: Isaiah 45:4
18681.text: For the sake of my servant Jacob and of Israel my chosen one, I even proceeded to call you by your name; I proceeded to give you a name of honor, although you did not know me.

18682.label: Isaiah 45:5
18682.text: I am Jehovah, and there is no one else. With the exception of me there is no God. I shall closely gird you, although you have not known me,

18683.label: Isaiah 45:6
18683.text: in order that people may know from the rising of the sun and from its setting that there is none besides me. I am Jehovah, and there is no one else.

18684.label: Isaiah 45:7
18684.text: Forming light and creating darkness, making peace and creating calamity, I, Jehovah, am doing all these things.

18685.label: Isaiah 45:8
18685.text: “O YOU heavens, cause a dripping from above; and let the cloudy skies themselves trickle with righteousness. Let the earth open up, and let it be fruitful with salvation, and let it cause righteousness itself to spring up at the same time. I myself, Jehovah, have created it.”

18686.label: Isaiah 45:9
18686.text: Woe to the one that has contended with his Former, as an earthenware fragment with the other earthenware fragments of the ground! Should the clay say to its former: “What do you make?” And your achievement [say]: “He has no hands”?

18687.label: Isaiah 45:10
18687.text: Woe to the one saying to a father: “What do you become father to?” and to the wife: “What are you in birth pains with?”

18688.label: Isaiah 45:11
18688.text: This is what Jehovah has said, the Holy One of Israel and the Former of him: “Ask me even about the things that are coming concerning my sons; and concerning the activity of my hands YOU people should command me.

18689.label: Isaiah 45:12
18689.text: I myself have made the earth and have created even man upon it. I—my own hands have stretched out the heavens, and all the army of them I have commanded.”

18690.label: Isaiah 45:13
18690.text: “I myself have roused up someone in righteousness, and all his ways I shall straighten out. He is the one that will build my city, and those of mine in exile he will let go, not for a price nor for bribery,” Jehovah of armies has said.

18691.label: Isaiah 45:14
18691.text: This is what Jehovah has said: “The unpaid laborers of Egypt and the merchants of E·thi·oʹpi·a and the Sa·beʹans, tall men, will themselves come over even to you, and yours they will become. Behind you they will walk; in fetters they will come over, and to you they will bow down. To you they will pray, [saying,] ‘Indeed God is in union with you, and there is no one else; there is no [other] God.’”

18692.label: Isaiah 45:15
18692.text: Truly you are a God keeping yourself concealed, the God of Israel, a Savior.

18693.label: Isaiah 45:16
18693.text: They will certainly be ashamed and even be humiliated, all of them. Together in humiliation the manufacturers of [idol] forms will have to walk.

18694.label: Isaiah 45:17
18694.text: As for Israel, he will certainly be saved in union with Jehovah with a salvation for times indefinite. YOU people will not be ashamed, nor will YOU be humiliated for the indefinite times of eternity.

18695.label: Isaiah 45:18
18695.text: For this is what Jehovah has said, the Creator of the heavens, He the [true] God, the Former of the earth and the Maker of it, He the One who firmly established it, who did not create it simply for nothing, who formed it even to be inhabited: “I am Jehovah, and there is no one else.

18696.label: Isaiah 45:19
18696.text: In a place of concealment I spoke not, in a dark place of the earth; nor said I to the seed of Jacob, ‘Seek me simply for nothing, YOU people.’ I am Jehovah, speaking what is righteous, telling what is upright.

18697.label: Isaiah 45:20
18697.text: “Collect yourselves and come. Bring yourselves up close together, YOU escapees from the nations. Those carrying the wood of their carved image have not come to any knowledge, neither have those praying to a god that cannot save.

18698.label: Isaiah 45:21
18698.text: Make YOUR report and YOUR presentation. Yes, let them consult together in unity. Who has caused this to be heard from a long time ago? [Who] has reported it from that very time? Is it not I, Jehovah, besides whom there is no other God; a righteous God and a Savior, there being none excepting me?

18699.label: Isaiah 45:22
18699.text: “Turn to me and be saved, all YOU [at the] ends of the earth; for I am God, and there is no one else.

18700.label: Isaiah 45:23
18700.text: By my own self I have sworn —out of my own mouth in righteousness the word has gone forth, so that it will not return —that to me every knee will bend down, every tongue will swear,

18701.label: Isaiah 45:24
18701.text: saying, ‘Surely in Jehovah there are full righteousness and strength. All those getting heated up against him will come straight to him and be ashamed.

18702.label: Isaiah 45:25
18702.text: In Jehovah all the seed of Israel will prove to be right and will boast about themselves.’”

18703.label: Isaiah 46:1
18703.text: Bel has bent down, Neʹbo is stooping over; their idols have come to be for the wild beasts and for the domestic animals, their loads, pieces of luggage, a burden for the tired animals.

18704.label: Isaiah 46:2
18704.text: They must stoop over; they must each alike bend down; they are simply unable to furnish escape for the burden, but into captivity their own soul must go.

18705.label: Isaiah 46:3
18705.text: “Listen to me, O house of Jacob, and all YOU remaining ones of the house of Israel, YOU the ones conveyed [by me] from the belly, the ones carried from the womb.

18706.label: Isaiah 46:4
18706.text: Even to [one’s] old age I am the same One; and to [one’s] gray-headedness I myself shall keep bearing up. I myself shall certainly act, that I myself may carry and that I myself may bear up and furnish escape.

18707.label: Isaiah 46:5
18707.text: “To whom will YOU people liken me or make [me] equal or compare me that we may resemble each other?

18708.label: Isaiah 46:6
18708.text: There are those who are lavishing out the gold from the purse, and with the scale beam they weigh out the silver. They hire a metalworker, and he makes it into a god. They prostrate themselves, yes, they bow down.

18709.label: Isaiah 46:7
18709.text: They carry it upon the shoulder, they bear it and deposit it in its place that it may stand still. From its standing place it does not move away. One even cries out to it, but it does not answer; out of one’s distress it does not save one.

18710.label: Isaiah 46:8
18710.text: “Remember this, that YOU people may muster up courage. Lay it to heart, YOU transgressors.

18711.label: Isaiah 46:9
18711.text: Remember the first things of a long time ago, that I am the Divine One and there is no other God, nor anyone like me;

18712.label: Isaiah 46:10
18712.text: the One telling from the beginning the finale, and from long ago the things that have not been done; the One saying, ‘My own counsel will stand, and everything that is my delight I shall do’;

18713.label: Isaiah 46:11
18713.text: the One calling from the sunrising a bird of prey, from a distant land the man to execute my counsel. I have even spoken [it]; I shall also bring it in. I have formed [it], I shall also do it.

18714.label: Isaiah 46:12
18714.text: “Listen to me, YOU the ones powerful at heart, YOU the ones far away from righteousness.

18715.label: Isaiah 46:13
18715.text: I have brought near my righteousness. It is not far away, and my own salvation will not be late. And I will give in Zion salvation, to Israel my beauty.”

18716.label: Isaiah 47:1
18716.text: Come down and sit down in the dust, O virgin daughter of Babylon. Sit down on the earth where there is no throne, O daughter of the Chal·deʹans. For you will not experience again that people call you delicate and dainty.

18717.label: Isaiah 47:2
18717.text: Take a hand mill and grind out flour. Uncover your veil. Strip off the flowing skirt. Uncover the leg. Cross over the rivers.

18718.label: Isaiah 47:3
18718.text: You ought to uncover your nakedness. Also, your reproach ought to be seen. Vengeance is what I shall take, and I shall not meet any man [kindly].

18719.label: Isaiah 47:4
18719.text: “There is One repurchasing us. Jehovah of armies is his name, the Holy One of Israel.”

18720.label: Isaiah 47:5
18720.text: Sit down silently and come into the darkness, O daughter of the Chal·deʹans; for you will not experience again that people call you Mistress of Kingdoms.

18721.label: Isaiah 47:6
18721.text: I grew indignant at my people. I profaned my inheritance, and I proceeded to give them into your hand. You showed them no mercies. Upon the old man you made your yoke very heavy.

18722.label: Isaiah 47:7
18722.text: And you kept saying: “To time indefinite I shall prove to be Mistress, forever.” You did not take these things to your heart; you did not remember the finale of the matter.

18723.label: Isaiah 47:8
18723.text: And now hear this, you pleasure-given [woman], the one sitting in security, the one saying in her heart: “I am, and there is nobody else. I shall not sit as a widow, and I shall not know the loss of children.”

18724.label: Isaiah 47:9
18724.text: But to you these two things will come suddenly, in one day: loss of children and widowhood. In their complete measure they must come upon you, for the abundance of your sorceries, for the full might of your spells—exceedingly.

18725.label: Isaiah 47:10
18725.text: And you kept trusting in your badness. You have said: “There is no one seeing me.” Your wisdom and your knowledge —this is what has led you away; and you keep saying in your heart: “I am, and there is nobody else.”

18726.label: Isaiah 47:11
18726.text: And upon you calamity must come; you will know no charming against it. And upon you adversity will fall; you will not be able to avert it. And upon you there will suddenly come a ruin that you are not accustomed to know.

18727.label: Isaiah 47:12
18727.text: Stand still, now, with your spells and with the abundance of your sorceries, in which you have toiled from your youth; that perhaps you might be able to benefit, that perhaps you might strike people with awe.

18728.label: Isaiah 47:13
18728.text: You have grown weary with the multitude of your counselors. Let them stand up, now, and save you, the worshipers of the heavens, the lookers at the stars, those giving out knowledge at the new moons concerning the things that will come upon you.

18729.label: Isaiah 47:14
18729.text: Look! They have become like stubble. A fire itself will certainly burn them up. They will not deliver their soul from the power of the flame. There will be no glow of charcoals for people to warm themselves, no firelight in front of which to sit down.

18730.label: Isaiah 47:15
18730.text: Thus they will certainly become to you, with whom you have toiled as your charmers from your youth. They will actually wander, each one to his own region. There will be no one to save you.

18731.label: Isaiah 48:1
18731.text: Hear this, O house of Jacob, YOU who are calling yourselves by the name of Israel and who have come forth from the very waters of Judah, YOU who are swearing by the name of Jehovah and who make mention even of the God of Israel, not in truth and not in righteousness.

18732.label: Isaiah 48:2
18732.text: For they have called themselves as being from the holy city, and upon the God of Israel they have supported themselves, Jehovah of armies being his name.

18733.label: Isaiah 48:3
18733.text: “The first things I have told even from that time, and out of my own mouth they went forth, and I kept making them heard. Suddenly I acted, and the things proceeded to come in.

18734.label: Isaiah 48:4
18734.text: Due to my knowing that you are hard and that your neck is an iron sinew and your forehead is copper,

18735.label: Isaiah 48:5
18735.text: I also kept telling you from that time. Before it could come in, I caused you to hear [it], that you might not say, ‘My own idol has done them, and my own carved image and my own molten image have commanded them.’

18736.label: Isaiah 48:6
18736.text: You have heard. Behold it all. As for YOU people, will YOU not tell [it]? I have made you hear new things from the present time, even things kept in reserve, that you have not known.

18737.label: Isaiah 48:7
18737.text: At the present time they must be created, and not from that time, even things that before today you have not heard, that you may not say, ‘Look! I have already known them.’

18738.label: Isaiah 48:8
18738.text: “Moreover, you have not heard, neither have you known, nor from that time on has your ear been opened. For I well know that without fail you kept dealing treacherously, and a ‘transgressor from the belly’ you have been called.

18739.label: Isaiah 48:9
18739.text: For the sake of my name I shall check my anger, and for my praise I shall restrain myself toward you that there may be no cutting you off.

18740.label: Isaiah 48:10
18740.text: Look! I have refined you, but not in [the form of] silver. I have made choice of you in the smelting furnace of affliction.

18741.label: Isaiah 48:11
18741.text: For my own sake, for my own sake I shall act, for how could one let oneself be profaned? And to no one else shall I give my own glory.

18742.label: Isaiah 48:12
18742.text: “Listen to me, O Jacob, and you Israel my called one. I am the same One. I am the first. Moreover, I am the last.

18743.label: Isaiah 48:13
18743.text: Moreover, my own hand laid the foundation of the earth, and my own right hand extended out the heavens. I am calling to them, that they may keep standing together.

18744.label: Isaiah 48:14
18744.text: “Be collected together, all YOU people, and hear. Who among them has told these things? Jehovah himself has loved him. He will do what is his delight upon Babylon, and his own arm will be upon the Chal·deʹans.

18745.label: Isaiah 48:15
18745.text: I—I myself have spoken. Moreover, I have called him. I have brought him in, and there will be a making of his way successful.

18746.label: Isaiah 48:16
18746.text: “Come near to me, YOU people. Hear this. From the start I have spoken in no place of concealment at all. From the time of its occurring I have been there.” And now the Sovereign Lord Jehovah himself has sent me, even his spirit.

18747.label: Isaiah 48:17
18747.text: This is what Jehovah has said, your Repurchaser, the Holy One of Israel: “I, Jehovah, am your God, the One teaching you to benefit [yourself], the One causing you to tread in the way in which you should walk.

18748.label: Isaiah 48:18
18748.text: O if only you would actually pay attention to my commandments! Then your peace would become just like a river, and your righteousness like the waves of the sea.

18749.label: Isaiah 48:19
18749.text: And your offspring would become just like the sand, and the descendants from your inward parts like the grains of it. One’s name would not be cut off or be annihilated from before me.”

18750.label: Isaiah 48:20
18750.text: Go forth, YOU people, out of Babylon! Run away from the Chal·deʹans. Tell forth even with the sound of a joyful cry, cause this to be heard. Make it to go forth to the extremity of the earth. Say: “Jehovah has repurchased his servant Jacob.

18751.label: Isaiah 48:21
18751.text: And they did not get thirsty when he was making them walk even through devastated places. Water out of the rock he caused to flow forth for them, and he proceeded to split a rock that the water might stream forth.”

18752.label: Isaiah 48:22
18752.text: “There is no peace,” Jehovah has said, “for the wicked ones.”

18753.label: Isaiah 49:1
18753.text: Listen to me, O YOU islands, and pay attention, YOU national groups far away. Jehovah himself has called me even from the belly. From the inward parts of my mother he has made mention of my name.

18754.label: Isaiah 49:2
18754.text: And he proceeded to make my mouth like a sharp sword. In the shadow of his hand he has hidden me. And he gradually made me a polished arrow. He concealed me in his own quiver.

18755.label: Isaiah 49:3
18755.text: And he went on to say to me: “You are my servant, O Israel, you the one in whom I shall show my beauty.”

18756.label: Isaiah 49:4
18756.text: But as for me, I said: “It is for nothing that I have toiled. For unreality and vanity I have used up my own power. Truly my judgment is with Jehovah, and my wages with my God.”

18757.label: Isaiah 49:5
18757.text: And now Jehovah, the One forming me from the belly as a servant belonging to him, has said [for me] to bring back Jacob to him, in order that to him Israel itself may be gathered. And I shall be glorified in the eyes of Jehovah, and my own God will have become my strength.

18758.label: Isaiah 49:6
18758.text: And he proceeded to say: “It has been more than a trivial matter for you to become my servant to raise up the tribes of Jacob and to bring back even the safeguarded ones of Israel; I also have given you for a light of the nations, that my salvation may come to be to the extremity of the earth.”

18759.label: Isaiah 49:7
18759.text: This is what Jehovah, the Repurchaser of Israel, his Holy One, has said to him that is despised in soul, to him that is detested by the nation, to the servant of rulers: “Kings themselves will see and certainly rise up, [and] princes, and they will bow down, by reason of Jehovah, who is faithful, the Holy One of Israel, who chooses you.”

18760.label: Isaiah 49:8
18760.text: This is what Jehovah has said: “In a time of goodwill I have answered you, and in a day of salvation I have helped you; and I kept safeguarding you that I might give you as a covenant for the people, to rehabilitate the land, to bring about the repossessing of the desolated hereditary possessions,

18761.label: Isaiah 49:9
18761.text: to say to the prisoners, ‘Come out!’ to those who are in the darkness, ‘Reveal yourselves!’ By the ways they will pasture, and on all beaten paths their pasturing will be.

18762.label: Isaiah 49:10
18762.text: They will not go hungry, neither will they go thirsty, nor will parching heat or sun strike them. For the One who is having pity upon them will lead them, and by the springs of water he will conduct them.

18763.label: Isaiah 49:11
18763.text: And I will make all my mountains a way, and my highways themselves will be on an elevation.

18764.label: Isaiah 49:12
18764.text: Look! These will come even from far away, and, look! these from the north and from the west, and these from the land of Siʹnim.”

18765.label: Isaiah 49:13
18765.text: Give a glad cry, YOU heavens, and be joyful, you earth. Let the mountains become cheerful with a glad outcry. For Jehovah has comforted his people, and he shows pity upon his own afflicted ones.

18766.label: Isaiah 49:14
18766.text: But Zion kept saying: “Jehovah has left me, and Jehovah himself has forgotten me.”

18767.label: Isaiah 49:15
18767.text: Can a wife forget her suckling so that she should not pity the son of her belly? Even these women can forget, yet I myself shall not forget you.

18768.label: Isaiah 49:16
18768.text: Look! Upon [my] palms I have engraved you. Your walls are in front of me constantly.

18769.label: Isaiah 49:17
18769.text: Your sons have hurried up. The very ones tearing you down and devastating you will go forth even from you.

18770.label: Isaiah 49:18
18770.text: Raise your eyes all around and see. They have all of them been collected together. They have come to you. “As I am living,” is the utterance of Jehovah, “with all of them you will clothe yourself just as with ornaments, and you will bind them on yourself like a bride.

18771.label: Isaiah 49:19
18771.text: Although there are your devastated places and your desolated places and the land of your ruins, although now you are too cramped to be dwelling, and those swallowing you down have been far away,

18772.label: Isaiah 49:20
18772.text: yet in your own ears the sons of your bereaved state will say, ‘The place has become too cramped for me. Do make room for me, that I may dwell.’

18773.label: Isaiah 49:21
18773.text: And you will for certain say in your heart, ‘Who has become father to these for me, since I am a woman bereaved of children and sterile, gone into exile and taken prisoner? As for these, who has brought [them] up? Look! I myself had been left behind alone. These—where have they been?’”

18774.label: Isaiah 49:22
18774.text: This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah has said: “Look! I shall raise up my hand even to the nations, and to the peoples I shall lift up my signal. And they will bring your sons in the bosom, and upon the shoulder they will carry your own daughters.

18775.label: Isaiah 49:23
18775.text: And kings must become caretakers for you, and their princesses nursing women for you. With faces to the earth they will bow down to you, and the dust of your feet they will lick up; and you will have to know that I am Jehovah, of whom those hoping in me will not be ashamed.”

18776.label: Isaiah 49:24
18776.text: Can those already taken be taken from a mighty man himself, or can the body of captives of the tyrant make their escape?

18777.label: Isaiah 49:25
18777.text: But this is what Jehovah has said: “Even the body of captives of the mighty man will be taken away, and those already taken by the tyrant himself will make their escape. And against anyone contending against you I myself shall contend, and your own sons I myself shall save.

18778.label: Isaiah 49:26
18778.text: And I will make those maltreating you eat their own flesh; and as with the sweet wine they will become drunk with their own blood. And all flesh will have to know that I, Jehovah, am your Savior and your Repurchaser, the Powerful One of Jacob.”

18779.label: Isaiah 50:1
18779.text: This is what Jehovah has said: “Where, then, is the divorce certificate of the mother of YOU people, whom I sent away? Or which one of my creditors is it to whom I have sold YOU people? Look! Because of YOUR own errors YOU have been sold, and because of YOUR own transgressions YOUR mother has been sent away.

18780.label: Isaiah 50:2
18780.text: Why is it that, when I came in, there was no one? When I called, there was nobody answering? Has my hand become in fact so short that it cannot redeem, or is there in me no power to deliver? Look! With my rebuke I dry up the sea; I make rivers a wilderness. Their fish stink due to there being no water, and they die because of thirst.

18781.label: Isaiah 50:3
18781.text: I clothe the heavens with obscurity, and I make sackcloth itself their covering.”

18782.label: Isaiah 50:4
18782.text: The Sovereign Lord Jehovah himself has given me the tongue of the taught ones, that I may know how to answer the tired one with a word. He awakens morning by morning; he awakens my ear to hear like the taught ones.

18783.label: Isaiah 50:5
18783.text: The Sovereign Lord Jehovah himself has opened my ear, and I, for my part, was not rebellious. I did not turn in the opposite direction.

18784.label: Isaiah 50:6
18784.text: My back I gave to the strikers, and my cheeks to those plucking off [the hair]. My face I did not conceal from humiliating things and spit.

18785.label: Isaiah 50:7
18785.text: But the Sovereign Lord Jehovah himself will help me. That is why I shall not have to feel humiliated. That is why I have set my face like a flint, and I know that I shall not be ashamed.

18786.label: Isaiah 50:8
18786.text: The One declaring me righteous is near. Who can contend with me? Let us stand up together. Who is my judicial antagonist? Let him approach me.

18787.label: Isaiah 50:9
18787.text: Look! The Sovereign Lord Jehovah himself will help me. Who is there that can pronounce me wicked? Look! All of them, like a garment, will wear out. A mere moth will eat them up.

18788.label: Isaiah 50:10
18788.text: Who among YOU people is in fear of Jehovah, listening to the voice of his servant, who has walked in continual darkness and for whom there has been no brightness? Let him trust in the name of Jehovah and support himself upon his God.

18789.label: Isaiah 50:11
18789.text: “Look! All YOU who are igniting a fire, making sparks light up, walk in the light of YOUR fire, and amid the sparks that YOU have set ablaze. From my hand YOU will certainly come to have this: In sheer pain YOU will lie down.

18790.label: Isaiah 51:1
18790.text: “Listen to me, YOU people who are pursuing after righteousness, YOU who are seeking to find Jehovah. Look to the rock from which YOU were hewn out, and to the hollow of the pit from which YOU were dug out.

18791.label: Isaiah 51:2
18791.text: Look to Abraham YOUR father and to Sarah who gradually brought YOU forth with childbirth pains. For he was one when I called him, and I proceeded to bless him and to make him many.

18792.label: Isaiah 51:3
18792.text: For Jehovah will certainly comfort Zion. He will for certain comfort all her devastated places, and he will make her wilderness like Eʹden and her desert plain like the garden of Jehovah. Exultation and rejoicing themselves will be found in her, thanksgiving and the voice of melody.

18793.label: Isaiah 51:4
18793.text: “Pay attention to me, O my people; and you national group of mine, to me give ear. For from me a law itself will go forth, and my judicial decision I shall cause to repose even as a light to the peoples.

18794.label: Isaiah 51:5
18794.text: My righteousness is near. My salvation will certainly go forth, and my own arms will judge even the peoples. In me the islands themselves will hope, and for my arm they will wait.

18795.label: Isaiah 51:6
18795.text: “Raise YOUR eyes to the heavens themselves, and look at the earth beneath. For the very heavens must be dispersed in fragments just like smoke, and like a garment the earth itself will wear out, and its inhabitants themselves will die like a mere gnat. But as for my salvation, it will prove to be even to time indefinite, and my own righteousness will not be shattered.

18796.label: Isaiah 51:7
18796.text: “Listen to me, YOU the ones knowing righteousness, the people in whose heart is my law. Do not be afraid of the reproach of mortal men, and do not be struck with terror just because of their abusive words.

18797.label: Isaiah 51:8
18797.text: For the moth will eat them up just as if a garment, and the clothes moth will eat them up just as if wool. But as for my righteousness, it will prove to be even to time indefinite, and my salvation to unnumbered generations.”

18798.label: Isaiah 51:9
18798.text: Awake, awake, clothe yourself with strength, O arm of Jehovah! Awake as in the days of long ago, as during the generations of times long past. Are you not the one that broke Raʹhab to pieces, that pierced the sea monster?

18799.label: Isaiah 51:10
18799.text: Are you not the one that dried up the sea, the waters of the vast deep? The one that made the depths of the sea a way for the repurchased ones to go across?

18800.label: Isaiah 51:11
18800.text: Then the redeemed ones of Jehovah themselves will return and must come to Zion with a joyful outcry, and rejoicing to time indefinite will be upon their head. To exultation and rejoicing they will attain. Grief and sighing will certainly flee away.

18801.label: Isaiah 51:12
18801.text: “I—I myself am the One that is comforting YOU people. “Who are you that you should be afraid of a mortal man that will die, and of a son of mankind that will be rendered as mere green grass?

18802.label: Isaiah 51:13
18802.text: And that you should forget Jehovah your Maker, the One stretching out the heavens and laying the foundation of the earth, so that you were in dread constantly the whole day long on account of the rage of the one hemming [you] in, as though he was all set to bring [you] to ruin? And where is the rage of the one hemming [you] in?

18803.label: Isaiah 51:14
18803.text: “The one stooping in chains will certainly be loosened speedily, that he may not go in death to the pit and that his bread may not be lacking.

18804.label: Isaiah 51:15
18804.text: “But I, Jehovah, am your God, the One stirring up the sea that its waves may be boisterous. Jehovah of armies is his name.

18805.label: Isaiah 51:16
18805.text: And I shall put my words in your mouth, and with the shadow of my hand I shall certainly cover you, in order to plant the heavens and lay the foundation of the earth and say to Zion, ‘You are my people.’

18806.label: Isaiah 51:17
18806.text: “Rouse yourself, rouse yourself, rise up, O Jerusalem, you who have drunk at the hand of Jehovah his cup of rage. The goblet, the cup causing reeling, you have drunk, you have drained out.

18807.label: Isaiah 51:18
18807.text: There was none of all the sons that she brought to birth conducting her, and there was none of all the sons that she brought up taking hold of her hand.

18808.label: Isaiah 51:19
18808.text: Those two things were befalling you. Who will sympathize with you? Despoiling and breakdown, and hunger and sword! Who will comfort you?

18809.label: Isaiah 51:20
18809.text: Your own sons have swooned away. They have lain down at the head of all the streets like the wild sheep in the net, as those who are full of the rage of Jehovah, the rebuke of your God.”

18810.label: Isaiah 51:21
18810.text: Therefore listen to this, please, O woman afflicted and drunk, but not with wine.

18811.label: Isaiah 51:22
18811.text: This is what your Lord, Jehovah, even your God, who contends for his people, has said: “Look! I will take away from your hand the cup causing reeling. The goblet, my cup of rage—you will not repeat the drinking of it anymore.

18812.label: Isaiah 51:23
18812.text: And I will put it in the hand of the ones irritating you, who have said to your soul, ‘Bow down that we may cross over,’ so that you used to make your back just like the earth, and like the street for those crossing over.”

18813.label: Isaiah 52:1
18813.text: Wake up, wake up, put on your strength, O Zion! Put on your beautiful garments, O Jerusalem, the holy city! For no more will there come again into you the uncircumcised and unclean one.

18814.label: Isaiah 52:2
18814.text: Shake yourself free from the dust, rise up, take a seat, O Jerusalem. Loosen for yourself the bands on your neck, O captive daughter of Zion.

18815.label: Isaiah 52:3
18815.text: For this is what Jehovah has said: “It was for nothing that YOU people were sold, and it will be without money that YOU will be repurchased.”

18816.label: Isaiah 52:4
18816.text: For this is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah has said: “It was to Egypt that my people went down in the first instance to reside there as aliens; and without cause As·syrʹi·a, for its part, oppressed them.”

18817.label: Isaiah 52:5
18817.text: “And now, what interest do I have here?” is the utterance of Jehovah. “For my people were taken for nothing. The very ones ruling over them kept howling,” is the utterance of Jehovah, “and constantly, all day long, my name was being treated with disrespect.

18818.label: Isaiah 52:6
18818.text: For that reason my people will know my name, even for that reason in that day, because I am the One that is speaking. Look! It is I.”

18819.label: Isaiah 52:7
18819.text: How comely upon the mountains are the feet of the one bringing good news, the one publishing peace, the one bringing good news of something better, the one publishing salvation, the one saying to Zion: “Your God has become king!”

18820.label: Isaiah 52:8
18820.text: Listen! Your own watchmen have raised [their] voice. In unison they keep crying out joyfully; for it will be eye into eye that they will see when Jehovah gathers back Zion.

18821.label: Isaiah 52:9
18821.text: Become cheerful, cry out joyfully in unison, YOU devastated places of Jerusalem, for Jehovah has comforted his people; he has repurchased Jerusalem.

18822.label: Isaiah 52:10
18822.text: Jehovah has bared his holy arm before the eyes of all the nations; and all the ends of the earth must see the salvation of our God.

18823.label: Isaiah 52:11
18823.text: Turn away, turn away, get out of there, touch nothing unclean; get out from the midst of her, keep yourselves clean, YOU who are carrying the utensils of Jehovah.

18824.label: Isaiah 52:12
18824.text: For YOU people will get out in no panic, and YOU will go in no flight. For Jehovah will be going even before YOU, and the God of Israel will be YOUR rear guard.

18825.label: Isaiah 52:13
18825.text: Look! My servant will act with insight. He will be in high station and will certainly be elevated and exalted very much.

18826.label: Isaiah 52:14
18826.text: To the extent that many have stared at him in amazement —so much was the disfigurement as respects his appearance more than that of any other man and as respects his stately form more than that of the sons of mankind —

18827.label: Isaiah 52:15
18827.text: he will likewise startle many nations. At him kings will shut their mouth, because what had not been recounted to them they will actually see, and to what they had not heard they must turn their consideration.

18828.label: Isaiah 53:1
18828.text: Who has put faith in the thing heard by us? And as for the arm of Jehovah, to whom has it been revealed?

18829.label: Isaiah 53:2
18829.text: And he will come up like a twig before one, and like a root out of waterless land. No stately form does he have, nor any splendor; and when we shall see him, there is not the appearance so that we should desire him.

18830.label: Isaiah 53:3
18830.text: He was despised and was avoided by men, a man meant for pains and for having acquaintance with sickness. And there was as if the concealing of one’s face from us. He was despised, and we held him as of no account.

18831.label: Isaiah 53:4
18831.text: Truly our sicknesses were what he himself carried; and as for our pains, he bore them. But we ourselves accounted him as plagued, stricken by God and afflicted.

18832.label: Isaiah 53:5
18832.text: But he was being pierced for our transgression; he was being crushed for our errors. The chastisement meant for our peace was upon him, and because of his wounds there has been a healing for us.

18833.label: Isaiah 53:6
18833.text: Like sheep we have all of us wandered about; it was each one to his own way that we have turned; and Jehovah himself has caused the error of us all to meet up with that one.

18834.label: Isaiah 53:7
18834.text: He was hard pressed, and he was letting himself be afflicted; yet he would not open his mouth. He was being brought just like a sheep to the slaughtering; and like a ewe that before her shearers has become mute, he also would not open his mouth.

18835.label: Isaiah 53:8
18835.text: Because of restraint and of judgment he was taken away; and who will concern himself even with [the details of] his generation? For he was severed from the land of the living ones. Because of the transgression of my people he had the stroke.

18836.label: Isaiah 53:9
18836.text: And he will make his burial place even with the wicked ones, and with the rich class in his death, despite the fact that he had done no violence and there was no deception in his mouth.

18837.label: Isaiah 53:10
18837.text: But Jehovah himself took delight in crushing him; he made him sick. If you will set his soul as a guilt offering, he will see his offspring, he will prolong [his] days, and in his hand what is the delight of Jehovah will succeed.

18838.label: Isaiah 53:11
18838.text: Because of the trouble of his soul he will see, he will be satisfied. By means of his knowledge the righteous one, my servant, will bring a righteous standing to many people; and their errors he himself will bear.

18839.label: Isaiah 53:12
18839.text: For that reason I shall deal him a portion among the many, and it will be with the mighty ones that he will apportion the spoil, due to the fact that he poured out his soul to the very death, and it was with the transgressors that he was counted in; and he himself carried the very sin of many people, and for the transgressors he proceeded to interpose.

18840.label: Isaiah 54:1
18840.text: “Cry out joyfully, you barren woman that did not give birth! Become cheerful with a joyful outcry and cry shrilly, you that had no childbirth pains, for the sons of the desolated one are more numerous than the sons of the woman with a husbandly owner,” Jehovah has said.

18841.label: Isaiah 54:2
18841.text: “Make the place of your tent more spacious. And let them stretch out the tent cloths of your grand tabernacle. Do not hold back. Lengthen out your tent cords, and make those tent pins of yours strong.

18842.label: Isaiah 54:3
18842.text: For to the right and to the left you will break forth, and your own offspring will take possession even of nations, and they will inhabit even the desolated cities.

18843.label: Isaiah 54:4
18843.text: Do not be afraid, for you will not be put to shame; and do not feel humiliated, for you will not be disappointed. For you will forget even the shame of your time of youth, and the reproach of your continuous widowhood you will remember no more.”

18844.label: Isaiah 54:5
18844.text: “For your Grand Maker is your husbandly owner, Jehovah of armies being his name; and the Holy One of Israel is your Repurchaser. The God of the whole earth he will be called.

18845.label: Isaiah 54:6
18845.text: For Jehovah called you as if you were a wife left entirely and hurt in spirit, and as a wife of the time of youth who was then rejected,” your God has said.

18846.label: Isaiah 54:7
18846.text: “For a little moment I left you entirely, but with great mercies I shall collect you together.

18847.label: Isaiah 54:8
18847.text: With a flood of indignation I concealed my face from you for but a moment, but with loving-kindness to time indefinite I will have mercy upon you,” your Repurchaser, Jehovah, has said.

18848.label: Isaiah 54:9
18848.text: “This is just as the days of Noah to me. Just as I have sworn that the waters of Noah shall no more pass over the earth, so I have sworn that I will not become indignant toward you nor rebuke you.

18849.label: Isaiah 54:10
18849.text: For the mountains themselves may be removed, and the very hills may stagger, but my loving-kindness itself will not be removed from you, nor will my covenant of peace itself stagger,” Jehovah, the One having mercy upon you, has said.

18850.label: Isaiah 54:11
18850.text: “O woman afflicted, tempest-tossed, uncomforted, here I am laying with hard mortar your stones, and I will lay your foundation with sapphires.

18851.label: Isaiah 54:12
18851.text: And I will make your battlements of rubies, and your gates of fiery glowing stones, and all your boundaries of delightsome stones.

18852.label: Isaiah 54:13
18852.text: And all your sons will be persons taught by Jehovah, and the peace of your sons will be abundant.

18853.label: Isaiah 54:14
18853.text: You will prove to be firmly established in righteousness itself. You will be far away from oppression —for you will fear none—and from anything terrifying, for it will not come near you.

18854.label: Isaiah 54:15
18854.text: If anyone should at all make an attack, it will not be at my orders. Whoever is making an attack upon you will fall even on account of you.”

18855.label: Isaiah 54:16
18855.text: “Look! I myself have created the craftsman, the one blowing upon the fire of charcoal and bringing forth a weapon as his workmanship. I myself, too, have created the ruinous man for wrecking work.

18856.label: Isaiah 54:17
18856.text: Any weapon whatever that will be formed against you will have no success, and any tongue at all that will rise up against you in the judgment you will condemn. This is the hereditary possession of the servants of Jehovah, and their righteousness is from me,” is the utterance of Jehovah.

18857.label: Isaiah 55:1
18857.text: Hey there, all YOU thirsty ones! Come to the water. And the ones that have no money! Come, buy and eat. Yes, come, buy wine and milk even without money and without price.

18858.label: Isaiah 55:2
18858.text: Why do YOU people keep paying out money for what is not bread, and why is YOUR toil for what results in no satisfaction? Listen intently to me, and eat what is good, and let YOUR soul find its exquisite delight in fatness itself.

18859.label: Isaiah 55:3
18859.text: Incline YOUR ear and come to me. Listen, and YOUR soul will keep alive, and I shall readily conclude with YOU people an indefinitely lasting covenant respecting the loving-kindnesses to David that are faithful.

18860.label: Isaiah 55:4
18860.text: Look! As a witness to the national groups I have given him, as a leader and commander to the national groups.

18861.label: Isaiah 55:5
18861.text: Look! A nation that you do not know you will call, and those of a nation who have not known you will run even to you, for the sake of Jehovah your God, and for the Holy One of Israel, because he will have beautified you.

18862.label: Isaiah 55:6
18862.text: Search for Jehovah, YOU people, while he may be found. Call to him while he proves to be near.

18863.label: Isaiah 55:7
18863.text: Let the wicked man leave his way, and the harmful man his thoughts; and let him return to Jehovah, who will have mercy upon him, and to our God, for he will forgive in a large way.

18864.label: Isaiah 55:8
18864.text: “For the thoughts of YOU people are not my thoughts, nor are my ways YOUR ways,” is the utterance of Jehovah.

18865.label: Isaiah 55:9
18865.text: “For as the heavens are higher than the earth, so my ways are higher than YOUR ways, and my thoughts than YOUR thoughts.

18866.label: Isaiah 55:10
18866.text: For just as the pouring rain descends, and the snow, from the heavens and does not return to that place, unless it actually saturates the earth and makes it produce and sprout, and seed is actually given to the sower and bread to the eater,

18867.label: Isaiah 55:11
18867.text: so my word that goes forth from my mouth will prove to be. It will not return to me without results, but it will certainly do that in which I have delighted, and it will have certain success in that for which I have sent it.

18868.label: Isaiah 55:12
18868.text: “For with rejoicing YOU people will go forth, and with peace YOU will be brought in. The mountains and the hills themselves will become cheerful before YOU with a joyful outcry, and the very trees of the field will all clap their hands.

18869.label: Isaiah 55:13
18869.text: Instead of the thicket of thorns the juniper tree will come up. Instead of the stinging nettle the myrtle tree will come up. And it must become for Jehovah something famous, a sign to time indefinite that will not be cut off.”

18870.label: Isaiah 56:1
18870.text: This is what Jehovah has said: “Keep justice, YOU people, and do what is righteous. For my salvation is at hand to come in, and my righteousness to be revealed.

18871.label: Isaiah 56:2
18871.text: Happy is the mortal man that does this, and the son of mankind that lays hold of it, keeping the sabbath in order not to profane it, and keeping his hand in order not to do any kind of badness.

18872.label: Isaiah 56:3
18872.text: And let not the foreigner that has joined himself to Jehovah say, ‘Without doubt Jehovah will divide me off from his people.’ Neither let the eunuch say, ‘Look! I am a dry tree.’”

18873.label: Isaiah 56:4
18873.text: For this is what Jehovah has said to the eunuchs that keep my sabbaths and that have chosen what I have delighted in and that are laying hold of my covenant:

18874.label: Isaiah 56:5
18874.text: “I will even give to them in my house and within my walls a monument and a name, something better than sons and daughters. A name to time indefinite I shall give them, one that will not be cut off.

18875.label: Isaiah 56:6
18875.text: “And the foreigners that have joined themselves to Jehovah to minister to him and to love the name of Jehovah, in order to become servants to him, all those keeping the sabbath in order not to profane it and laying hold of my covenant,

18876.label: Isaiah 56:7
18876.text: I will also bring them to my holy mountain and make them rejoice inside my house of prayer. Their whole burnt offerings and their sacrifices will be for acceptance upon my altar. For my own house will be called even a house of prayer for all the peoples.”

18877.label: Isaiah 56:8
18877.text: The utterance of the Sovereign Lord Jehovah, who is collecting together the dispersed ones of Israel, is: “I shall collect together to him others besides those already collected together of his.”

18878.label: Isaiah 56:9
18878.text: All YOU wild animals of the open field, come to eat, all YOU wild animals in the forest.

18879.label: Isaiah 56:10
18879.text: His watchmen are blind. None of them have taken note. All of them are speechless dogs; they are not able to bark, panting, lying down, loving to slumber.

18880.label: Isaiah 56:11
18880.text: They are even dogs strong in soul[ful desire]; they have known no satisfaction. They are also shepherds that have not known how to understand. They have all of them turned to their own way, each one for his unjust gain from his own border:

18881.label: Isaiah 56:12
18881.text: “Come, men! Let me take some wine; and let us drink intoxicating liquor to the limit. And tomorrow will certainly turn out just as today, great in a very much larger way.”

18882.label: Isaiah 57:1
18882.text: The righteous one himself has perished, but there is no one taking [it] to heart. And men of loving-kindness are being gathered [to the dead], while no one discerns that it is because of the calamity that the righteous one has been gathered away.

18883.label: Isaiah 57:2
18883.text: He enters into peace; they take rest upon their beds, [each] one that is walking straightforwardly.

18884.label: Isaiah 57:3
18884.text: “As for YOU men, come up close here, YOU sons of a soothsaying woman, the seed of an adulterous person and of a woman that commits prostitution:

18885.label: Isaiah 57:4
18885.text: Over whom is it that YOU have a jolly good time? Against whom do YOU keep opening wide the mouth, keep sticking out the tongue? Are YOU not the children of transgression, the seed of falsehood,

18886.label: Isaiah 57:5
18886.text: those who are working up passion among big trees, under every luxuriant tree, slaughtering the children in the torrent valleys under the clefts of the crags?

18887.label: Isaiah 57:6
18887.text: “With the smooth stones of the torrent valley was your portion. They—they were your lot. Moreover, to them you poured out a drink offering, you offered up a gift. For these things shall I comfort myself?

18888.label: Isaiah 57:7
18888.text: Upon a mountain high and lifted up you set your bed. There also you went up to offer sacrifice.

18889.label: Isaiah 57:8
18889.text: And behind the door and the doorpost you set your memorial. For apart from me you uncovered [yourself] and proceeded to go up; you made your bed spacious. And for yourself you went concluding a covenant with them. You loved a bed with them. The male organ you beheld.

18890.label: Isaiah 57:9
18890.text: And you proceeded to descend toward Melʹech with oil, and kept making your ointments abundant. And you continued sending your envoys far off, so that you lowered matters to Sheʹol.

18891.label: Isaiah 57:10
18891.text: In the multitude of your ways you have toiled. You have not said, ‘It is hopeless!’ You have found a revival of your own power. That is why you have not grown sick.

18892.label: Isaiah 57:11
18892.text: “Whom did you become frightened at and begin to fear, so that you took up lying? But I was not the one that you remembered. You took nothing to your heart. Was I not keeping silent and hiding matters? So you were in no fear even of me.

18893.label: Isaiah 57:12
18893.text: I myself shall tell forth your righteousness and your works, that they will not benefit you.

18894.label: Isaiah 57:13
18894.text: When you cry for aid your collection of things will not deliver you, but a wind will carry even all of them away. An exhalation will take them away, but the one taking refuge in me will inherit the land and will take possession of my holy mountain.

18895.label: Isaiah 57:14
18895.text: And one will certainly say, ‘Bank up, YOU people, bank up! Clear the way. Remove any obstacle from the way of my people.’”

18896.label: Isaiah 57:15
18896.text: For this is what the High and Lofty One, who is residing forever and whose name is holy, has said: “In the height and in the holy place is where I reside, also with the one crushed and lowly in spirit, to revive the spirit of the lowly ones and to revive the heart of the ones being crushed.

18897.label: Isaiah 57:16
18897.text: For it will not be to time indefinite that I shall contend, nor perpetually that I shall be indignant; for because of me the spirit itself would grow feeble, even the breathing creatures that I myself have made.

18898.label: Isaiah 57:17
18898.text: “At the erroneousness of his unjust gain I grew indignant, and I proceeded to strike him, concealing [my face], while I was indignant. But he kept walking as a renegade in the way of his heart.

18899.label: Isaiah 57:18
18899.text: I have seen his very ways; and I began to heal him and conduct him and make compensation with comfort to him and to his mourning ones.”

18900.label: Isaiah 57:19
18900.text: “I am creating the fruit of the lips. Continuous peace there will be to the one that is far away and to the one that is near,” Jehovah has said, “and I will heal him.”

18901.label: Isaiah 57:20
